items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Remote - MX Who We Are Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually. The Opportunity As a Sr. Data Engineer at Oportun, you will be a key member of our team, responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining sophisticated software / data platforms in achieving the charter of the engineering group. Your mastery of a technical domain enables you to take up business problems and solve them with a technical solution. With your depth of expertise and leadership abilities, you will actively contribute to architectural decisions, mentor junior engineers, and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality, scalable software solutions that advance our impact in the market. This is a role where you will have the opportunity to take up responsibility in leading the technology effort – from technical requirements gathering to final successful delivery of the product - for large initiatives (cross-functional and multi-month-long projects). At Oportun, we move fast and we hold each other to a high bar. If you care about doing your best work while actually moving the needle for real people, you'll fit right in. What You'll Do Your day-to-day You’ll design and implement scalable, efficient, and reliable data architectures that support business and analytical needs. You’ll build and maintain data pipelines, ETL processes, and integration solutions for large volumes of structured and unstructured data. You’ll optimize data pipelines, databases, data warehouses, and data lakes for performance, reliability, scalability, and security. You’ll partner with stakeholders to understand data requirements, develop domain expertise, and translate business needs into effective data models and solutions. You’ll establish and improve data quality standards, validation rules, documentation, and governance practices. You’ll implement monitoring and observability practices to identify bottlenecks, improve performance, and strengthen platform reliability. You’ll provide technical leadership on architecture, scalability, reliability, monitoring, integration, and extensibility. You’ll lead and contribute to code reviews, helping maintain high standards for code quality, performance, and maintainability. You’ll mentor junior engineers and support a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence. You’ll take ownership of production issues, including troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, escalation, and long-term resolution. You’ll independently lead multiple features and projects, coordinate work across engineers, and keep stakeholders informed of progress, risks, and dependencies. You’ll help evolve engineering tools, platforms, and practices and encourage adoption of better ways of working. You’ll look for practical ways to use AI tools to improve engineering productivity, analysis, documentation, and problem-solving. Who You Are The right fit looks like this You’re a hands-on data engineer who enjoys solving complex technical problems and building systems that others depend on. You combine strong technical depth with a practical understanding of business needs and know how to turn ambiguous requirements into scalable solutions. You take ownership, communicate clearly, and are comfortable leading technical work without relying on formal authority. You enjoy mentoring others and helping teams make stronger technical decisions. What You Bring Skills & experience Required 8+ years of experience in data engineering, with strong experience in data architecture, ETL, and database management. Strong programming skills in Python or PySpark, plus experience with Java or Scala. Experience building complex end-to-end data pipelines and data integration solutions. Strong knowledge of SQL and experience with relational and NoSQL database technologies. Experience with big data technologies such as Spark, Kafka, Hadoop, or similar platforms. Experience with orchestration and scheduling tools such as Airflow, Databricks, Jenkins, or similar technologies. Experience designing and operating scalable, reliable, and secure data systems. Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP and associated data services. Experience working in Agile environments such as Scrum, Lean, or Kanban. Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills. Experience mentoring junior engineers and contributing to technical leadership within a team. Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams. Nice to Have Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field. Databricks experience or certification. Experience with AWS Redshift, S3, Azure SQL Data Warehouse, or comparable cloud data services. Experience implementing data governance, data quality, or observability frameworks. Experience leading cross-functional or multi-month engineering initiatives. Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools to improve development, troubleshooting, documentation, or productivity. Our AI Mindset We build with AI. We lead with judgment. AI isn't a feature here. It's how we work. We're excited about what AI makes possible, and we're looking for people who share that curiosity. You don't need to be an expert. You need to be open to experimenting , willing to learn, and able to apply new tools in ways that actually move the needle. In this role, you'll be encouraged to explore AI tools, find practical use cases for your function, and bring ideas for working smarter. We believe the best outcomes come when human judgment and AI capability work together. Why Oportun What's in it for you Oportun offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support your physical, financial, and professional well-being. Benefits vary by country of employment. Some of the benefits available to eligible employees include: Mexico Benefits: Medical Insurance Savings Fund and Life Insurance Vacation and Parental Leave Internet and Electricity Allowance Eligibility and plan details vary by location and employment status. To learn more about Oportun and our benefits, visit oportun.com/careers #LI-REMOTE #LI-GK1 We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment opportunities without regard to race, age, color, religion, gender, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status or any other category protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. California applicants can find a copy of Oportun's CCPA Notice here: https://oportun.com/privacy/california-privacy-notice/ . We will never request personal identifiable information (bank, credit card, etc.) before you are hired. We do not charge you for pre-employment fees such as background checks, training, or equipment. If you think you have been a victim of fraud by someone posing as us, please report your experience to the FBI’s Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3). To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/oportun-sr-data-analytics-engineer-r14153

items.description: Du verstehst KI-Systeme bis ins Detail. Und Du kannst sie einem Geschäftsführer so erklären, dass er die richtige Entscheidung trifft. Wir wollen die KI-Expert:innen im Mittelstand sein. Nicht die, die am lautesten über KI reden, sondern die, die wissen, warum ein RAG-System schlechte Antworten liefert, welches Modell lokal betrieben werden kann und welcher Use Case in drei Monaten Wirkung zeigt. Dafür suchen wir Menschen, die beides mitbringen: echte technische Tiefe und Erfahrung darin, Kunden durch Projekte zu führen. Als Senior AI Solutions Engineer bei Neurawork verantwortest Du Kundenprojekte von der ersten Analyse bis zum Go-live. Du nimmst Prozesse und Datenlage auf, bewertest Use Cases auf Machbarkeit und Wirkung, entwirfst die Architektur und setzt die Lösung selbst um, auf Basis unserer standardisierten Produkte und bis zur vollständigen Integration in die Systemlandschaft des Kunden. Der Kunde vertraut Dir, weil Du technisch weißt, wovon Du sprichst. Wir arbeiten nach unserem eigenen Operational-AI-Vorgehensmodell. Wir sind keine Automation-Agentur und keine Custom-Softwareentwickler: Standardisierte Produkte sind unser Hebel, und wir passen sie bis zur vollständigen Integration an. Wir schaffen echten, messbaren Mehrwert und stehen dafür ein. Aufgaben Was Du bei uns machst Projekte verantworten: Kundenprojekte im Mittelstand führen, vom Kick-off bis zur Übergabe in den Betrieb Bewerten: Prozesse und Daten beim Kunden verstehen, Use Cases auf Machbarkeit, Kosten und Grenzen prüfen und nach Wirkung priorisieren Selbst bauen: Architektur entwerfen, unsere Produkte konfigurieren und erweitern, Retrieval und Prompting optimieren, Qualität messbar machen Integrieren: Schnittstellen, Datenanbindung, Sicherheit und Betrieb gemeinsam mit der Kunden-IT umsetzen Beraten mit Substanz: Fachabteilung, IT und Geschäftsführung fundiert begleiten, Erwartungen klar steuern, Roadmaps entwickeln, die technisch tragen Menschen mitnehmen: Workshops moderieren und Teilnehmende befähigen, damit die Lösung im Alltag ankommt Weitergeben: Erkenntnisse in unsere Frameworks und Produkte zurückspielen; Live-Sessions in unserer KI-Ausbildung mit TÜV Süd Zertifikat und im KI-Business-Coaching Nicht passend für Dich, wenn... Nicht passend für Dich, wenn … Du KI-Projekte bisher gesteuert oder begleitet, aber nicht selbst technisch umgesetzt hast, Deine KI-Systeme ausschließlich mit No-Code-Tools entstanden sind, Du am liebsten nur im Code bleibst und Kundentermine, Workshops oder Gespräche mit der Geschäftsführung lieber anderen überlässt Qualifikation Was Du mitbringst Technisches Fundament: Abgeschlossenes Studium im MINT-Bereich (z. B. Informatik, Mathematik, Physik, Ingenieurwissenschaften, Data Science). Alternativ mehrere Jahre professionelle Softwareentwicklung. Zertifikatskurse und Weiterbildungen ersetzen das nicht. Mindestens ein KI-System, das Du selbst konzipiert und umgesetzt hast und zeigen kannst, z. B. eine RAG-Pipeline, einen produktiven Agenten oder eine technisch verantwortete Automatisierung Du programmierst sicher (z. B. Python) und arbeitest mit APIs, Datenbanken und Deployment. Reine No-Code- oder Low-Code-Erfahrung reicht für diese Rolle nicht. Du kannst technische Entscheidungen begründen, z. B. warum Du ein Modell, eine Chunking-Strategie oder einen Cloud- statt lokalen Betrieb gewählt hast und wo deren Grenzen liegen Beratungserfahrung: 4+ Jahre Berufserfahrung, davon mindestens 2 Jahre mit direktem Kundenkontakt in technischen Projekten, z. B. als Technical Consultant, Solutions Engineer, Solution Architect, Data-/AI-Consultant, technische Projektleitung oder Freelancer mit eigenen Kunden. Interne Fachbereiche als Kunden zählen auch. Du hast Anforderungen aufgenommen, Workshops moderiert und Entscheidungen bei Stakeholdern herbeigeführt, auch auf Geschäftsführungsebene Du kannst einem Kunden sagen, dass sein Wunsch-Use-Case keinen Sinn ergibt, und ihm eine bessere Alternative zeigen Außerdem wichtig: Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau (C2) in Wort und Schrift Gutes Englisch, Wohnsitz in Deutschland und Bereitschaft zu Kundenterminen vor Ort Was wir bieten Projektverantwortung ab dem ersten Mandat, ohne Layer über Dir; direkter Draht zum Founding-Team Beide Welten in einer Rolle: selbst bauen und selbst beraten, ohne Übergaben zwischen Beratung und Entwicklung Ein Team, das technisch auf Augenhöhe diskutiert: Austausch mit der KI-Elite in Deutschland Framework-driven statt ad hoc, und Du gestaltest die Frameworks mit Wert statt Stunden: Uns zählen Ergebnisse, nicht Tagessätze Moderner Tech-Stack und Raum zum Experimentieren Sichtbarkeit als Expertise über unsere KI-Business-Coaching-Community und die TÜV-SÜD-Kooperation Voll-remote möglich; Teamtage und Kundenworkshops vor Ort, üblicherweise 2–4 Tage im Monat im DACH-Raum Bewerbung: Bring Dein Projekt mit! Schick uns Deinen Lebenslauf und beantworte kurz zwei Fragen: Dein Projekt (3–5 Sätze): Welches KI-System würdest Du uns im Zweitgespräch zeigen? Was löst es, wie ist es aufgebaut, welchen Teil hast Du selbst umgesetzt, und welche technische Entscheidung hast Du dabei bewusst getroffen? Ein Link zu GitHub, einem Demo-Video o. Ä. ist willkommen. Dein Kunde (2–3 Sätze): Beschreib eine Situation, in der Du einen Kunden oder Fachbereich von einer technischen Entscheidung überzeugt oder seine Erwartungen korrigiert hast. Was war die Ausgangslage, was hast Du getan, was kam heraus? Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich, Dein Projekt und Deine Kundengeschichte kennenzulernen! Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us! Location Overview: Find us in the city of Chester, a destination renowned for its culture, history, and beauty. Working at Bank of America Chester offers a far-reaching global career for a world-renowned organisation, whilst being ideally situated against the backdrop of the rolling North Wales hills and the banks of the serene River Dee. Role Description: This role will enhance security compliance, reduce exposure to cyber threats, improve reporting accuracy, increase automation, and enable more effective management of patching and vulnerability remediation activities across the enterprise. The position is essential for maintaining operational resilience and supporting strategic technology risk management objectives. Responsibilities: Key responsibilities include working with stakeholders to understand their needs; analysing problems; capturing requirements; creating solutions; solving problems through automation; and providing subject-matter expertise to support scope and requirement decisions. The role also involves collaborating with project stakeholders to analyse and confirm requirements, improve processes, and write user and technical stories. As a critical liaison between the Patching and Currency team and its stakeholders, this role defines, analyses, and delivers technology solutions that support strategic business objectives. items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: United States URL: https://www.clickguard.com/ We are seeking a hands-on, systems-driven RevOps Manager to own the data, tools, and processes behind every stage of our revenue funnel: signup, trial, paid, renewal, expansion, and churn. ClickGuard will run four motions on the same stack: a self-serve trial, a sales-assisted motion for larger advertisers, outbound to advertisers and PPC agencies, and an agency partner program. This role makes sure a trial, a paying customer, and a dollar of MRR are counted the same way in HubSpot, Stripe, PostHog, and every report built on them. This is an AI-first operations role for someone who has personally built revenue systems that leadership used to run the business, and who uses AI to do the work of a larger ops team. You will own our CRM, our funnel data, the weekly revenue scorecard, and the workflows that move accounts from one stage to the next. Your superpower is turning messy, disconnected data into numbers people act on. You treat RevOps as a data and systems problem first, and an admin problem second. Every workflow you build has an owner, a test, and an alert when it breaks, so a broken lead flow shows up in your inbox the same day it breaks and gets fixed before it reaches the quarter-end numbers. Using AI tools is the baseline. We want someone who can show what they have personally built with AI, how it changed their workflow or capacity, and what measurable impact it had on data quality, speed, conversion, revenue, or headcount efficiency. What You'll Own HubSpot end-to-end: object model (contacts, companies, workspaces, deals, tickets), lifecycle stages, pipelines, properties, workflows, and permissions, with one owner per field and every critical workflow tested and monitored The revenue data layer (built with our engineering and data team): the app, Stripe, and HubSpot feeding PostHog, with shared definitions for trial, paid, MRR, churn, expansion, and reactivation that every report uses Funnel instrumentation and attribution: source captured at signup, account qualification by measured ad spend, and a clear trail from first touch to trial to paid to renewal AI-powered RevOps systems at scale: build and operate workflows where AI materially increases throughput across enrichment, routing, lead and account scoring, health scoring, data hygiene, and reporting. You should be able to demonstrate systems you have personally built and the business results they produced. The weekly revenue scorecard for the leadership meeting, pulled from source data; and the operating processes behind sales and customer success: quote and discount approvals, agency account handovers, refunds, chargebacks, and failed-payment recovery. You're a Fit If You've personally rebuilt a CRM that a revenue team relied on, and you can show the before and after: workflows fixed, fields retired, duplicate records merged, and reports leadership started to trust. You have built real AI-powered workflows and can show what you built, where AI sat in the workflow, what it automated or augmented, and the measurable impact it created. You understand subscription revenue well enough to reconcile MRR between Stripe and the CRM, and to explain why the two numbers differ Hands-on with HubSpot (Operations Hub or equivalent), SQL, CLI, API’s, Webhooks, n8n/Make, and Claude Code or Codex You can explain lifecycle stages, deal pipelines, and attribution models without Googling You treat product usage as revenue data: trial activity, connected ad accounts, and plan limits feed scoring and routing You're Not a Fit If Your experience is mostly building dashboards on top of data someone else had to fix You measure success in workflows built and tickets closed rather than conversion and revenue You need a team around you; this role is the builder for our foundation Required Skills & Experience 3-5+ Years in RevOps or Revenue Systems: Proven experience owning the CRM and revenue data for a B2B SaaS company, ideally one with a self-serve trial or product-led motion. You can show the numbers: data completeness, workflow reliability, funnel conversion, forecast accuracy, and time saved. CRM Architecture: Concrete experience designing an object model, lifecycle stages, and pipelines from scratch, or rebuilding a broken one, including migrations that keep the history intact. You document every field you create and retire the ones nobody uses. Data Ownership: You have personally owned the path from source system to report: event tracking, warehouse tables, SQL, and reconciliation against billing. When two systems disagree, you find out why before anyone reports the number. AI-Native Execution: You have personally built AI-powered systems inside a revenue workflow, including enrichment, scoring, routing, classification, data cleanup, forecasting, or agentic workflows. You can clearly explain what you built, why you built it, how it worked, and what measurable result it produced in terms of pipeline, revenue, productivity, speed, quality, or reduced manual work. Full-Funnel Accountability: You measure your work through the full chain from signup → trial → qualified account → paid → renewal → expansion. You can show examples where a process you built moved conversion or retention. You are comfortable killing your own workflows when the data says they are not helping. Cross-Team Range: Ability to work with sales, customer success, marketing, finance, and engineering: you write specs an engineer can build from and processes a sales rep will follow. Technical Proficiency HubSpot CRM Ecosystem: (Expert Level) Custom objects, associations, workflows, lifecycle stages, pipelines, properties, lists, permissions, and the HubSpot API. SQL & Product Analytics: (Working Level) Comfortable writing SQL against a warehouse (PostHog or equivalent) and joining product events with billing and CRM data. Billing Systems: Working fluency with Stripe: subscriptions, invoices, coupons, failed payments, and how each one shows up in MRR. Enrichment & Data APIs: Clay or equivalent, people and company data providers, and comfort consuming REST APIs and webhooks directly. Automation Engineering: Strong execution knowledge of workflow automation (n8n, Make, or native AI-agent integrations) and AI coding tools (Claude Code or Codex), connecting the stack without engineering support. Logistics Remote, async-first team culture. Must have overlapping availability for live syncs between 7 AM and 2 PM EST . Full-time, long-term position. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/clickguard-inc-revops-manager

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Remote - MX Who We Are Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually. The Opportunity As a Sr. Data Engineer at Oportun, you will be a key member of our team, responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining sophisticated software / data platforms in achieving the charter of the engineering group. Your mastery of a technical domain enables you to take up business problems and solve them with a technical solution. With your depth of expertise and leadership abilities, you will actively contribute to architectural decisions, mentor junior engineers, and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality, scalable software solutions that advance our impact in the market. This is a role where you will have the opportunity to take up responsibility in leading the technology effort – from technical requirements gathering to final successful delivery of the product - for large initiatives (cross-functional and multi-month-long projects). At Oportun, we move fast and we hold each other to a high bar. If you care about doing your best work while actually moving the needle for real people, you'll fit right in. What You'll Do Your day-to-day You’ll design and implement scalable, efficient, and reliable data architectures that support business and analytical needs. You’ll build and maintain data pipelines, ETL processes, and integration solutions for large volumes of structured and unstructured data. You’ll optimize data pipelines, databases, data warehouses, and data lakes for performance, reliability, scalability, and security. You’ll partner with stakeholders to understand data requirements, develop domain expertise, and translate business needs into effective data models and solutions. You’ll establish and improve data quality standards, validation rules, documentation, and governance practices. You’ll implement monitoring and observability practices to identify bottlenecks, improve performance, and strengthen platform reliability. You’ll provide technical leadership on architecture, scalability, reliability, monitoring, integration, and extensibility. You’ll lead and contribute to code reviews, helping maintain high standards for code quality, performance, and maintainability. You’ll mentor junior engineers and support a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence. You’ll take ownership of production issues, including troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, escalation, and long-term resolution. You’ll independently lead multiple features and projects, coordinate work across engineers, and keep stakeholders informed of progress, risks, and dependencies. You’ll help evolve engineering tools, platforms, and practices and encourage adoption of better ways of working. You’ll look for practical ways to use AI tools to improve engineering productivity, analysis, documentation, and problem-solving. Who You Are The right fit looks like this You’re a hands-on data engineer who enjoys solving complex technical problems and building systems that others depend on. You combine strong technical depth with a practical understanding of business needs and know how to turn ambiguous requirements into scalable solutions. You take ownership, communicate clearly, and are comfortable leading technical work without relying on formal authority. You enjoy mentoring others and helping teams make stronger technical decisions. What You Bring Skills & experience Required 8+ years of experience in data engineering, with strong experience in data architecture, ETL, and database management. Strong programming skills in Python or PySpark, plus experience with Java or Scala. Experience building complex end-to-end data pipelines and data integration solutions. Strong knowledge of SQL and experience with relational and NoSQL database technologies. Experience with big data technologies such as Spark, Kafka, Hadoop, or similar platforms. Experience with orchestration and scheduling tools such as Airflow, Databricks, Jenkins, or similar technologies. Experience designing and operating scalable, reliable, and secure data systems. Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP and associated data services. Experience working in Agile environments such as Scrum, Lean, or Kanban. Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills. Experience mentoring junior engineers and contributing to technical leadership within a team. Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams. Nice to Have Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field. Databricks experience or certification. Experience with AWS Redshift, S3, Azure SQL Data Warehouse, or comparable cloud data services. Experience implementing data governance, data quality, or observability frameworks. Experience leading cross-functional or multi-month engineering initiatives. Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools to improve development, troubleshooting, documentation, or productivity. Our AI Mindset We build with AI. We lead with judgment. AI isn't a feature here. It's how we work. We're excited about what AI makes possible, and we're looking for people who share that curiosity. You don't need to be an expert. You need to be open to experimenting , willing to learn, and able to apply new tools in ways that actually move the needle. In this role, you'll be encouraged to explore AI tools, find practical use cases for your function, and bring ideas for working smarter. We believe the best outcomes come when human judgment and AI capability work together. Why Oportun What's in it for you Oportun offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support your physical, financial, and professional well-being. Benefits vary by country of employment. Some of the benefits available to eligible employees include: Mexico Benefits: Medical Insurance Savings Fund Life Insurance Internet and Electricity Allowance Paid time off such as vacation and parental leave Eligibility and plan details vary by location and employment status. To learn more about Oportun and our benefits, visit oportun.com/careers #LI-REMOTE #LI-GK1 We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment opportunities without regard to race, age, color, religion, gender, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status or any other category protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. California applicants can find a copy of Oportun's CCPA Notice here: https://oportun.com/privacy/california-privacy-notice/ . We will never request personal identifiable information (bank, credit card, etc.) before you are hired. We do not charge you for pre-employment fees such as background checks, training, or equipment. If you think you have been a victim of fraud by someone posing as us, please report your experience to the FBI’s Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3). To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/oportun-senior-data-engineer-capital-markets-r13923

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: New York, NY; Remote, US (Hub cities) Maven Clinic is the world's largest virtual clinic for women and families on a mission to make healthcare work for all of us. Through Maven Enterprise, the company partners with more than 2,300 employers and health plans to provide end-to-end women's and family health programs spanning fertility and family building, maternity and newborn care, parenting and pediatrics, and menopause and midlife — improving clinical outcomes, reducing healthcare costs, and expanding equitable access to high-quality care at scale. Through its consumer platform, Maven provides direct access to virtual care across 30+ specialties, as well as dedicated hormone and GLP-1 care programs purpose-built for women. Founded in 2014 by CEO Kate Ryder, Maven Clinic has raised more than $425 million from leading healthcare and technology investors including General Catalyst, Sequoia, Dragoneer Investment Group, Oak HC/FT, StepStone Group, Icon Ventures, and Lux Capital. Recognized for innovation and industry leadership, Maven has been named to the TIME100 Most Influential Companies, CNBC Disruptor 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, and FORTUNE Best Places to Work. Learn more at mavenclinic.com An award-winning culture working towards an important mission – Maven Clinic is a recipient of over 30 workplace and innovation awards, including: TIME 100 Most Influential Companies (2023, 2026) Fortune Change the World (2024) CNBC Disruptor 50 List (2022, 2023, 2024) Fortune Best Workplaces for Millennials (2024) Fortune Best Workplaces in Health Care (2024) Fast Company Most Innovative Companies (2020, 2023) Fortune Best Workplaces NY (2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024) About the Role: Maven is looking for a Director of Marketing Operations who will own the systems, data, and reporting infrastructure behind our B2B Growth Marketing team — from HubSpot/Salesforce instrumentation to pipeline attribution to the budget that funds it all. This person will lead a team across marketing analytics, marketing operations, and web optimization, and serve as the go-to partner for Sales, RevOps, Strategic Finance, and Client Success on shared data and reporting. Reporting to the Senior Director of Growth, they'll bring structure and rigor to a fast-moving org, ensuring marketing's numbers hold up in front of executive leadership. What You’ll Do: Marketing Technology, Data & Attribution HubSpot instrumentation (and its integration with Salesforce): own lead management strategy, campaign orchestration and tracking, and stage definitions for the B2B funnel. Pipeline attribution: own marketing's multi-touch attribution methodology and represent it in cross-team pipeline conversations. Data governance: maintain data dictionaries and definitions (MQL/MQA thresholds, pipeline vs. bookings vs. revenue) so reporting stays consistent as tools and AI use expand. Martech stack: own B2B-facing tools and integrations, including CaliberMind, GA4, HubSpot, Qualified, Webflow, and evaluate new tooling as needs evolve. Training and enablement: ensure the has the resources and knowledge to own the reporting and orchestration of their channels. Analytics & Reporting KPI ownership: define and maintain B2B marketing metrics (MQLs, MQAs, pipeline coverage, Pipe-Spend ratio) and the reporting cadence behind them. Executive reporting: build and deliver pipeline briefings and performance readouts for B2B marketing leadership. Dashboards: own the B2B analytics stack across CaliberMind, Looker, Data Studio, Salesforce, and GA4, and keep it accurate as definitions change. FY planning support: partner with Strategic Finance and RevOps on fiscal year target-setting, run-rate projections, and scenario modeling for B2B pipeline and budget as well as org-level OKR setting. Budget & Planning Budget ownership: oversee the B2B marketing budget, including forecast, actuals, monthly reconciliation, and shifts across programs and months. Vendor management: track spend and manage relationships with external vendors. FY planning: lead annual and quarterly budgeting and planning for B2B Growth Marketing in partnership with Strategic Finance. Marketing Website & CRO Marketing website: manage the web team that owns navigation, landing pages, and on-page SEO/AEO for the Enterprise/B2B experience. Testing and optimization: run a structured A/B testing and CRO program for B2B landing pages. Accessibility: maintain WCAG 2.1 AA compliance across the B2B site experience. Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Partnership People leadership: manage and develop a team covering marketing analytics, marketing operations, and web optimization. Process and tooling: set the team's operating rhythm and own its project management tooling (Asana and Jira). Builds with AI: personally build AI-powered workflows for reporting, analysis, and campaign operations that enable the team to make better decisions and scale without additional headcount. AI enablement: lead rollout of AI tools within B2B Growth Marketing, including data governance for tools connected to live CRM and marketing data, and set the team's judgment for where AI helps and where it doesn't. Cross-functional partnership: serve as B2B Growth Marketing's primary point of contact for Sales, SDR, RevOps, Strategic Finance, and Client Success on shared data, process, and reporting questions. What You’ll Bring: 8+ years in B2B marketing operations, analytics, or revenue operations, ideally supporting complex or enterprise sales cycles. Hands-on ownership of a marketing automation platform (HubSpot or similar) and the integration with Salesforce, including lead routing, lifecycle stages, and campaign orchestration. Experience building and defending pipeline or marketing attribution models with Sales and Finance stakeholders. Track record owning multi-million dollar marketing budgets, including forecasting, actuals, and reconciliation. Experience owning a B2B marketing website and CRO program, including A/B testing and accessibility standards. Experience managing and developing a high performance team. Sharp, direct communicator, comfortable presenting pipeline and Marketing performance data to executive leadership. Comfortable operating in a fast-changing org structure and building processes from ambiguity. Experience rolling out AI tools within a marketing team, with an eye toward data governance and accuracy. The base salary range for this role is $170,000 - $200,000 per year. You will also be entitled to receive equity and benefits. Individual pay decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, and skillset. This role requires active work authorization in the US. Maven embraces a flexible hybrid work model. Our teams primarily operate from the New York Metropolitan area, NY, and remotely via San Francisco/Bay Area, CA, Seattle, WA. For those in our New York City office, we encourage in-person collaboration by requiring team members to work onsite three days a week (Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday). For those based in Boston, DC, Chicago, Seattle, and San Francisco, we encourage in-person collaboration by requiring team members to attend monthly Work Together Days within these cities. This policy aims to balance remote work flexibility with the benefits of face-to-face interaction. At Maven we believe that a diverse set of backgrounds and experiences enrich our teams and allow us to achieve above and beyond our goals. If you do not have experience in all of the areas detailed above, we hope that you will share your unique background with us in your application and how it can be additive to our teams. Benefits That Work For You Our benefits are designed to support your health, well-being and career development, helping you thrive both personally and professionally. We remain focused on providing a competitive benefits package for our employees. On top of standards such as employer-covered health, dental, and insurance plan options, we offer an inclusive approach to benefits: Maven for Mavens: access to the full platform and specialists, including care for mental health, reproductive health, family planning and pediatrics. Whole-self care through wellness partnerships Hybrid work, in office meals, and work together days 16 weeks 100% paid parental leave and new parent stipend (for Mavens who've been with us for 1 year+) Annual professional development stipend and access to a personal career coach through Maven for Mavens 401K matching for US-based employees, with immediate vesting These benefits are applicable to Maven Clinic Co., US-based, full-time employees only. 1099/Contract Providers are ineligible for these benefits. Maven is an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information. Maven is committed to providing access, equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. Maven Clinic interview requests and job offers only originate from an @mavenclinic.com email address (e.g jsmith@mavenclinic.com). Maven Clinic will never ask for sensitive information to be delivered over email or phone. If you receive a scam issue or a security issue involving Maven Clinic please notify us at: security@mavenclinic.com . For general and additional inquiries, please contact us at careers@mavenclinic.com . To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/maven-clinic-director-marketing-operations

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: United Kingdom (Remote) Who we are Typeform is a refreshingly different form builder. We help over 150,000 businesses collect the data they need with forms, surveys, and quizzes that people enjoy. Designed to look striking and feel effortless to fill out, Typeform drives 500 million responses every year—and integrates with essential tools like Slack, Zapier, and Hubspot. We’re excited to hire someone based in London , where we’re looking to grow our sales presence. About The Role Our team is still early in its evolution, operating with a start-up mindset within a scaling company. We're building stronger processes, a clearer operating model, and the foundation for our next stage of growth. We’re looking for someone who wants to help create that future—not just operate within it. As a Senior Account Executive reporting directly to the Head of Sales, you’ll be a key driver of our outbound engine. You’re a strategic seller who owns the full cycle, thrives on proactive outreach, and isn’t phased by cold calls or pipeline creation. You combine discipline with initiative, independence with collaboration, and urgency with long-term relationship-building. Your territory spans Mid-Market and Enterprise customers, blending short-cycle and long-cycle opportunities. But make no mistake: outbound is the heartbeat of this role. Things you will do: Outreach + engagement : contact leads via email, cold calls, conferences, and more. Manage inbound and referral leads. Lead gen + prospecting: research potential customers, generate leads, and build a consistent outbound sales pipeline. Attend industry events and develop connections to drive future sales growth. Qualification + closing : run discovery calls, demos, and follow-ups to qualify and close new customers. Build proposals and RoI cases that convince qualified prospects to buy Listen. Negotiate contract terms when needed. Process improvement: improve our internal sales processes (slides, call scripts, meeting templates, contract terms, CRM workflows, metrics, dashboards, etc.). Run weekly “Sales Review” meetings company-wide to review deals and answer questions. Cross-team work : work with Customer Success, Engineering, and Product to consistently delight customers. Work with our co-founding team on all things sales and revenue-related. What you already bring to the table: 5–8+ years of quota-carrying closing experience in B2B SaaS Experience selling into enterprise or upper mid-market accounts Proven ability to run consultative, multi-stakeholder sales cycles Track record of closing meaningful deals ($50K–$250K+) and expanding accounts Strong discovery and storytelling skills Comfortable balancing inbound + outbound pipeline generation Highly organized and proactive in managing deals end-to-end *Typeform drives hundreds of millions of interactions each year, enabling conversational, human-centered experiences across the globe. items.title: Senior Technical Account Manager, Xsolla Ads & Rewards at Xsolla
items.summary: ABOUT US Xsolla is a global commerce company with robust tools and services to help developers solve the inherent challenges of the video game industry. From indie to AAA, companies partner with Xsolla to help them fund, distribute, market, and monetize their games. Grounded in the belief in the future of video games, Xsolla is resolute in the miss
items.description: ABOUT US Xsolla is a global commerce company with robust tools and services to help developers solve the inherent challenges of the video game industry. From indie to AAA, companies partner with Xsolla to help them fund, distribute, market, and monetize their games. Grounded in the belief in the future of video games, Xsolla is resolute in the mission to bring opportunities together, and continually make new resources available to creators. Headquartered and incorporated in Los Angeles, California, Xsolla operates as the merchant of record and has helped over 1,500+ game developers to reach more players and grow their businesses around the world. With more paths to profits and ways to win, developers have all the things needed to enjoy the game. For more information, visit xsolla.com. ABOUT THE ROLE Xsolla Ads connects advertisers with players across Xsolla’s games and commerce surfaces. Every dollar that moves through it depends on two kinds of integration working correctly: the oRTB connections to the DSPs and SSPs that buy and sell our inventory, and the MMP and event integrations that tell advertisers whether a player installed, registered, or made a purchase. You’ll be the technical owner of those integrations for our strategic partners. That means you’re the person a DSP calls when their bid rate falls off a cliff, the person an MMP works with to get postbacks mapped correctly, and the person who tells an advertiser exactly why their dashboard and ours disagree. You’ll work with Partnerships, Product, Engineering, and Data, and you’ll bring what partners need back into the roadmap in a form engineers can act on. RESPONSIBILITIES oRTB integrations (supply and demand) Own technical onboarding for DSPs and SSPs, from spec review and test traffic through to production. Map bid requests and responses against oRTB 2. 5 ⁄ 2 .6, including partner-specific extensions, and catch mismatches before they cost money. Set up and maintain seats, deal IDs, and floors, and keep ads.txt, app-ads.txt, sellers.json, and SupplyChain object data accurate. Troubleshoot bid rate, win rate, timeouts, creative rejections, and revenue discrepancies down to root cause. MMP and event integrations Run integrations with MMPs such as AppsFlyer, Adjust, and Singular, plus direct advertiser postback setups. Configure install and in-app event postbacks: macros and parameter mapping, click IDs, event names and values, attribution windows, and postback authentication. Work with advertisers to define which in-app events matter for their campaigns and confirm they fire correctly before launch. Reconcile conversion discrepancies between Xsolla, MMPs, and advertisers, and explain the cause in plain terms. Strategic partner ownership Be the technical point of contact on partner calls, and answer hard integration questions in real time. Build integration plans and launch checklists, and stay close to partners through go-live. Bring technical health and integration status into partner business reviews. Voice of the partner Turn partner requests and defects into well-scoped tickets with reproduction steps, logs, and expected behavior. Give Product and Engineering early feedback on specs, so integration problems get caught on paper. Write and maintain partner-facing integration guides and internal runbooks. Data and reporting Use SQL and logs to investigate discrepancies, monitor integration health, and spot problems before partners do. Build simple dashboards and reports that show partner and integration performance. WHAT YOUR WEEK LOOKS LIKE A DSP’s bid rate drops 40% overnight. You pull sample bid requests, find a field that changed format in the last release, and coordinate the fix with Engineering. An MMP reports 18% fewer purchase events than we do. You trace it to event-value mapping and a deduplication rule, then agree the fix with both sides. An SSP’s sellers.json entry doesn’t match our app-ads.txt, and buyers are filtering the inventory. You find the mismatch and get both files corrected. A new advertiser wants to pay on day-7 retention. You work out which in-app events their MMP can send, map them, and test the postbacks end to end before the campaign goes live. You notice three partners hitting the same integration problem, and you write it up for Product with a proposed fix. QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS 5–8 years in ad tech in a technical account management, solutions engineering, integration engineering, or partner support role. Fluent in oRTB. You can read a bid request and response, explain what each object does, and spot what’s wrong. Hands-on experience setting up MMP integrations and debugging install and in-app event postbacks with at least one major MMP. Working knowledge of the supply chain transparency stack: ads.txt, app-ads.txt, sellers.json, and SupplyChain object. Strong with REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, and server logs. Comfortable writing SQL to answer your own questions. Experience as the technical owner for strategic partners such as DSPs, SSPs, MMPs, ad networks, or large advertisers. Clear communication with both engineers and non-technical partners, and calm under pressure when revenue is on the line. Ownership: you take a problem through to resolution rather than logging it and handing it off. Based in North America and able to work across North American time zones. Nice to have: Hands-on experience with Prebid: Prebid.js, Prebid Server, or Prebid Mobile. Familiarity with the Ad Context Protocol (AdCP) or other agent-to-agent advertising standards. A track record of using Claude or other AI tools to get more done: writing integration test scripts, analyzing logs, drafting partner docs, or automating repeat work. Come ready to show us a real example. Experience in mobile gaming, app monetization, rewarded ads, or offerwalls. Familiarity with privacy-safe measurement such as SKAdNetwork and Privacy Sandbox. HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED New partners go from signed to live on schedule, without integration surprises in production. Discrepancies get explained and closed, not left open as a standing argument. Partners come to you first and resolve issues with you rather than escalating around you. Engineering receives well-scoped tickets and spends less time on back-and-forth. We catch integration health problems before partners report them. BENEFITS We are passionate about fostering a supportive environment for our team, so we prioritize the physical, mental, and emotional well-being of our employees and their families through a comprehensive Benefits Program. This includes 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision plans, unlimited Flexible Time Off, and a personalized career roadmap for each employee. By investing in professional development through training and educational opportunities, we ensure that our team thrives both personally and professionally. Together, we’re not just building a business; we’re cultivating a community that values creativity, collaboration, and the transformative power of play. EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT Xsolla is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by law. We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in accordance with the Fair Chance Act. CRIMINAL HISTORY CONSIDERATION For the Senior Technical Account Manager, Programmatic & Measurement, we will conduct a background check that may include the following: Criminal history check Employment verification Education verification RELEVANCE TO JOB RESPONSIBILITIES The background check is relevant to this position because of the following role responsibilities: Accessing confidential company data Ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements RIGHTS UNDER THE FAIR CHANCE ACT Applicants are encouraged to inquire about their rights under the Fair Chance Act. If you have questions regarding our hiring practices, please contact [email protected]. By submitting the following job application form, you consent to Xsolla processing your data for career-related inquiries and potential employment opportunities. We process your data in accordance with this Xsolla Privacy Notice for Job Applicants . Please direct any inquiries regarding your data privacy to [email protected] . We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

items.description: The Company The energy industry is entering one of the most significant periods of growth and transformation in its history. Meeting the nation’s growing demand for reliable electricity will require new ideas, new infrastructure, and talented people committed to building for the future. At Cypress Creek Energy, we’re meeting that challenge by developing and operating the energy infrastructure needed to power communities, support economic opportunity, and strengthen resilience. We believe our responsibility extends beyond the grid and that how we build matters just as much as what we build. That same commitment extends to our employees. We invest in professional growth, encourage collaboration across teams, and provide opportunities to take ownership, expand your expertise, and advance your career. Our culture is grounded in safety, accountability, respect, and a shared commitment to deliver results. Join us and help meet one of the most important energy challenges of our time while building a rewarding career. Overview Cypress Creek is seeking a Director, OT Operations, Governance, and Cybersecurity to lead the strategy, delivery, and continuous improvement of the operational technology services that monitor and control our generation sites. This leader will be accountable for reliable OT operations, a consistent governance framework, adherence to NERC Regulatory Standards, and a risk-based cybersecurity program across SCADA and supporting infrastructure. The Director will establish priorities, lead technical teams and service providers, manage budgets and technology roadmaps, and partner with operations, engineering, IT, cybersecurity, and compliance to protect personnel, maintain availability, and support fleet growth without compromising safe operations. Responsibilities Define and execute a multiyear OT strategy and roadmap aligned with fleet growth, operational priorities, cybersecurity risk, and business objectives. Establish the OT operating model, service ownership, decision rights, accountability, and performance expectations across internal teams and service providers. Lead, mentor, and develop multidisciplinary OT operations, engineering, governance, and cybersecurity personnel. Develop annual operating and capital budgets, business cases, staffing plans, and investment priorities for OT services and infrastructure. Prioritize initiatives using risk, reliability, lifecycle condition, regulatory obligations, cost, and business value. Provide executive-level reporting on OT strategy, financial performance, resource needs, material risks, and delivery milestones. OT Cybersecurity Program Owner Own the OT cybersecurity program, control framework, roadmap, and risk-based priorities across generation sites and supporting infrastructure. Direct asset inventory, network segmentation, vulnerability management, secure configuration, patching, endpoint protection, and security monitoring practices. Establish requirements for identity, privileged access, multifactor authentication, vendor remote access, removable media, and transient cyber assets. Lead OT cyber incident preparedness, response, escalation, communications, lessons learned, and corrective-action tracking. Coordinate threat intelligence, detection engineering, security monitoring, and response workflows with enterprise cybersecurity and site operations. Measure and communicate cybersecurity maturity, control effectiveness, exposure trends, remediation progress, and residual risk. Regulatory Compliance Provide leadership and oversight for applicable regulatory obligations, including NERC CIP and O&P requirements and internal compliance commitments. Translate regulatory requirements into sustainable OT procedures, controls, evidence standards, ownership assignments, and operating routines. Maintain audit-ready documentation and evidence for access, configuration, patching, vulnerability, incident, recovery, and change-management controls. Partner with legal, compliance, operations, engineering, and cybersecurity teams to assess applicability and address control gaps. Lead readiness assessments, internal reviews, regulator or auditor engagement, evidence requests, and remediation planning. Track regulatory changes and update policies, standards, training, and technical controls within required time frames. OT Risk and Compliance Leader Establish and maintain an OT risk-management framework, risk register, control library, exception process, and accountable risk owners. Facilitate risk assessments for sites, systems, projects, vendors, architecture changes, acquisitions, and emerging threats. Evaluate risk in the context of personnel safety, reliable operations, generation availability, cybersecurity, regulatory exposure, and financial impact. Define remediation plans, compensating controls, target dates, escalation criteria, and formal risk-acceptance requirements. Align OT governance with recognized practices such as NIST CSF and NIST SP 800-82 while tailoring controls to operational realities. Report material risk, overdue remediation, policy exceptions, control deficiencies, and trends to appropriate governance forums. OT Strategy, leadership, and financial stewardship Direct reliable day-to-day delivery of SCADA, control systems, OT networks, servers, workstations, historians, communications, and supporting services. Establish service levels, operational procedures, on-call coverage, escalation paths, maintenance windows, and incident and problem-management practices. Govern change, configuration, release, capacity, availability, and lifecycle-management processes for production OT environments. Sponsor resilient architecture, tested backups, disaster recovery, continuity plans, redundancy, and restoration exercises. Coordinate commissioning, operational acceptance, documentation, support transition, and standardization for new or acquired assets. Drive root-cause analysis, corrective actions, technical-debt reduction, automation, and continuous improvement of OT services. OT Vendor and Third-Party Governance Owner Define security, service, documentation, support, resilience, notification, and access requirements for OT vendors and service providers. Lead technical due diligence, cybersecurity assessments, product selection, contract input, and onboarding for third parties and managed services. Govern vendor identities, privileged access, remote connectivity, session oversight, approval workflows, and timely access removal. Monitor service levels, control performance, vulnerabilities, end-of-life exposure, support quality, costs, and corrective actions. Ensure contracts address incident reporting, breach notification, evidence support, data handling, business continuity, and exit obligations. Maintain strategic supplier relationships and escalate material performance, cybersecurity, compliance, or delivery concerns. OT Cross-Functional Business Partner Partner with operations, engineering, asset management, IT, enterprise cybersecurity, compliance, legal, procurement, finance, and project delivery teams. Translate operational needs and technical risks into clear priorities, investment decisions, delivery plans, and executive recommendations. Align enterprise technology and security services with OT availability, safety, latency, supportability, and site-access requirements. Support project design reviews, architecture decisions, commissioning, acquisitions, integrations, and operational handoffs. Facilitate governance forums that resolve competing priorities, approve exceptions, assign accountability, and remove delivery barriers. Promote shared ownership of OT reliability, cybersecurity, compliance, lifecycle planning, and continuous improvement across the organization. OT Performance and Assurance Define key performance, risk, control, service, reliability, recovery, financial, and delivery indicators for the OT function. Establish dashboards and reporting cadences that provide timely, accurate, and actionable visibility to operational and executive stakeholders. Monitor service availability, incidents, vulnerabilities, patch status, backup success, recovery testing, lifecycle exposure, and remediation performance. Conduct control testing, service reviews, maturity assessments, post-incident reviews, and independent assurance activities as appropriate. Validate that corrective actions are evidence-based, sustainably implemented, assigned to accountable owners, and completed on schedule. Use performance and risk trends to drive investment decisions, resource allocation, process improvement, and roadmap adjustments. Education & Experience Required Advanced technical degree in fields such as engineering, computer science, information systems, or a related technical field. 10+ years of relevant experience, including 5+ years of leadership; in OT operations, ICS/SCADA, industrial cybersecurity, or critical infrastructure technology. Demonstrated experience leading technical teams, managing vendors and budgets, and delivering multiyear operational or Cybersecurity programs across distributed facilities. Experience overseeing technical and regulatory teams and programs, along with elevating program maturity. Proven success in implementing and maintaining regulatory compliance programs. Knowledgeable of NERC processes and ability to oversee audits and data requests. Experience establishing governance, risk management, change control, compliance evidence, and tested business continuity and disaster recovery processes. Ability to translate technical and operational risks into executive decisions, build cross-functional alignment, and balance Cybersecurity, reliability, cost, and business priorities. Embrace and live by the mission and values of Cypress Creek Energy Preferred Qualifications Leadership experience supporting ICS/SCADA or OT environments in solar, storage, wind, utilities, or other distributed energy infrastructure. Experience leading NERC CIP and O&P compliance support, evidence readiness, and audit remediation Familiarity with NIST 800-82 and NIST CSF. Experience selecting and governing the tools listed below or comparable products, including vendor evaluation, service integration, and lifecycle planning. Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CRISC, GICSP, or CEH. Location: The position is remote, with travel up to 25%. Benefits: 15 days of Paid Time Off, accrual up to 20 days, 11 observed holidays. 401(k) Match Comprehensive package including medical, dental, vision and health insurance Wellness stipend, family planning stipend, and generous parental leave Tuition Reimbursement Phone Bill Reimbursement Company Swag A note to Recruiting Agencies Cypress Creek Energy Human Resources team does not accept unsolicited resumes from third party recruiters, staffing firms, or related agencies. The Human Resources team coordinates all recruiting and hiring at our company. We do not accept resumes from third-party recruiters unless authorized by the Human Resources team and if a signed agreement is in place. Any unsolicited resumes will be considered property of CCE and we are not responsible for any related fees. All communication related to recruiting partnerships should ONLY be directed to the Human Resources team. Cypress Creek Energy is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status. We are committed to providing a workplace that is inclusive and values diversity, and we encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. Please be aware of recruiting scams—official communications will only come from @ccrenew.com, we will never request personal or financial information, and any suspicious activity should be reported to HR@ccrenew.com.

Product-Market Fit: Continuously assess and address client needs to ensure that our products maintain their relevance and effectiveness in the market. This involves staying updated on market trends, gathering client feedback, and making data-driven decisions to refine and improve our products. You will also need to understand SaaS interfaces, dashboards, charts, and reports to create user-friendly and insightful products. your profile To excel in this role, you need a blend of experience, technical knowledge, and analytical skills. These qualifications will enable you to understand the market, make informed decisions, and drive the development of successful products. Experience: Proven experience as a Product Manager or in a similar role within the advertising or software development fields. You should have a track record of successfully managing and launching products that meet market needs and drive business growth. SaaS Expertise: Good understanding of SaaS interfaces, dashboards, charts, and reports. This expertise is essential for developing user-friendly products that provide valuable insights and drive user engagement. AdTech Knowledge: A deep understanding of the online advertising technology landscape, including customer needs and market dynamics. Experience and knowledge in AdTech and online advertising are crucial. Knowledge and experience with affiliate marketing are a plus. Analytical Skills: Strong ability to analyze market data, interpret insights, and make informed decisions. This involves using data to prioritize product features, measure performance, and guide the product development process. You should also be comfortable with SaaS analytics and reporting tools to extract meaningful insights. Rapid Prototyping: Knowledge and experience with rapid prototyping techniques to quickly iterate and refine product concepts. This is crucial for fast-paced development cycles and ensuring that ideas are effectively translated into functional designs. We are looking for someone who not only meets the skill requirements but also brings additional qualities that will help drive our success. Your proficiency with tools, experience in scope management, and ability to lead and inspire are critical for this role. Product Management Tools: Proficient in using product management tools and methodologies such as Atlassian Product Discovery. These tools help streamline the product development process, ensure all team members are aligned, and facilitate efficient project management. Scope Management: Experience in transferring scope from Product Management to Product Owners for product development. This skill ensures that product development is focused and efficient, with clear responsibilities and timelines, leading to successful project execution. Wireframing & Prototyping: Familiarity with high-level wireframing and prototyping techniques. items.title: Director, AI-Enabled Fraud Prevention & Investigations
items.summary: Headquarters: Remote - USA Clover Health is investing in our fraud detection and investigation capabilities and is seeking a Director, AI-Enabled Fraud Prevention & Investigations to join our Legal department as a senior individual contributor. This hybrid role combines: (1) managing hands-on investigations of potential provider fraud with (2) buil
items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Remote - USA Clover Health is investing in our fraud detection and investigation capabilities and is seeking a Director, AI-Enabled Fraud Prevention & Investigations to join our Legal department as a senior individual contributor. This hybrid role combines: (1) managing hands-on investigations of potential provider fraud with (2) building AI-powered tools and processes to make investigations more efficient and help catch potential future fraud earlier. You will develop and pilot new AI-enabled investigatory processes for Clover’s Medicare Advantage business, and own resulting investigations, in collaboration with Clover’s Special Investigations Unit (SIU) and other stakeholders. This is a non-attorney role. You will work hand-in-hand with Clover’s lawyers and SIU to ensure that new investigatory processes you develop, and the resulting investigations, comply with Clover policies and regulatory requirements. Success in this role requires someone sharp, creative, and technically hands-on—someone who does not just use existing analytics tools but builds their own. That might mean writing a script to automate repetitive work, pulling apart a dataset when a standard report falls short, or working with an LLM until it produces something genuinely useful—all with the goal of finding smarter, more effective ways to investigate potential provider fraud. As a Director, AI-Enabled Fraud Prevention & Investigations, you will: Build Your Own Investigative Tooling: Use AI to write the queries, scripts, and prompts that turn millions of claim lines and/or medical record data into a prioritized list of leads. Prototype detection logic yourself rather than waiting on a roadmap, and hand off what works to data science and engineering to productionize. We expect you to be the person who builds v1. Investigate Potential Fraud End-to-End With AI in the Loop: Own a portfolio of fraud investigations sourced using the tooling you develop, in collaboration with Clover’s SIU. Develop investigative plans, gather and analyze evidence (including claims data and medical records), and reach well-supported conclusions. Use LLMs and analytics to compress the parts of an investigation that have always been slow — reading unstructured data, triaging grievance narratives, and sizing exposure. Build Defensible Documentation: Develop case files and memos that are factually complete, well-organized, and prepared with the evidentiary and procedural standards necessary for downstream enforcement, recoveries, or provider actions. Collaborate Across Functions: Work with Clover's clinical, compliance, claims, payment integrity, provider relations, revenue operations, and SIU teams to gather information, validate findings, and translate investigative outcomes into operational improvements, provider education, and member impact. Communicate Findings Clearly: Prepare concise written reports and oral briefings that translate complex investigative facts into clear narratives for senior leadership and other stakeholders. Success in this role looks like: In your first 90 days , you have embedded yourself as a trusted partner to both the Legal department and Clover’s SIU. You have built working relationships with key stakeholders across Clover's clinical, compliance, claims, payment integrity, revenue operations, and legal teams, and you have begun working through your initial portfolio of fraud investigations and ad hoc referrals. By 6 months , you are independently managing a steady caseload of fraud investigations with consistently high-quality work product, in collaboration with SIU. You have a clear working rhythm with Legal and SIU, and you have built at least one working tool — a script, a notebook, a dashboard, a prompt. By 12 months , you have a track record of strong investigations, successful recoveries and/or referrals, and effective cross-functional collaboration. Senior leaders across Clover view you as a trusted person to call when they have a hunch that something doesn't look right and want it examined. You should get in touch if: Knowledge of healthcare fraud schemes & investigative experience: You have experience in healthcare fraud investigations, program integrity, or SIU operations, ideally within Medicare Advantage or managed care. You understand healthcare fraud schemes and know how to use claims data, medical records, and provider documentation to build a defensible factual record. You are AI-native and enjoy building things using LLMs: You can use LLMs to write SQL, Python, etc., to interrogate large claims and/or medical record datasets, automate investigative work, and prototype your own solutions rather than waiting for someone else to build them. We do not expect production-grade engineering or require formal technical training—we value demonstrated ability to build, ship, and showcase solutions that work. Strong communication skills: You are a strong writer and communicator who can turn complex investigative findings into clear memos, referrals, and executive summaries, and you are comfortable building in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment. Bonus points if: You have built something people actually use—an internal tool, detection model, script, automation, or AI workflow that made a manual process better. We would rather see something scrappy and useful in production than something polished in a slide. You have hands-on experience applying AI/ML to fraud, investigations, or compliance. You have a J.D., legal training, or experience working alongside Legal, SIU, or compliance at a health plan. You have industry certifications such as CFE, AHFI, or CHC. Benefits Overview : Financial Well-Being : Our commitment to attracting and retaining top talent begins with a competitive base salary and equity opportunities. Additionally, we offer a performance-based bonus program, 401k matching, and regular compensation reviews to recognize and reward exceptional contributions. Physical Well-Being : We prioritize the health and well-being of our employees and their families by providing comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage. Your health matters to us, and we invest in ensuring you have access to quality healthcare. Mental Well-Being : We understand the importance of mental health in fostering productivity and maintaining work-life balance. To support this, we offer initiatives such as No-Meeting Fridays, monthly company holidays, access to mental health resources, and a generous flexible time-off policy. Additionally, we embrace a remote-first culture that supports collaboration and flexibility, allowing our team members to thrive from any location. Professional Development : Developing internal talent is a priority for Clover. We offer learning programs, mentorship, professional development funding, and regular performance feedback and reviews. Additional Perks: Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offering discounted equity opportunities Reimbursement for office setup expenses Monthly cell phone & internet stipend Remote-first culture, enabling collaboration with global teams Paid parental leave for all new parents And much more! About Clover: We are reinventing health insurance by combining the power of data with human empathy to keep our members healthier. We believe the healthcare system is broken, so we've created custom software and analytics to empower our clinical staff to intervene and provide personalized care to the people who need it most. We always put our members first, and our success as a team is measured by the quality of life of the people we serve. Those who work at Clover are passionate and mission-driven individuals with diverse areas of expertise, working together to solve the most complicated problem in the world: healthcare. From Clover’s inception, Diversity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, perspectives, opinions, and backgrounds, who share a passion for improving people's lives. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employee’s points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility. #LI-REMOTE Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We are an E-Verify company. Final pay is based on several factors including but not limited to internal equity, market data, and the applicant’s education, work experience, certifications, etc. A reasonable estimate of the base salary range for this role is: $150,000 — $240,000 USD To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/clover-health-director-ai-enabled-fraud-prevention-investigations
