items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: URL: http://cmswa.com Custom Mechanical Solutions delivers energy-efficient HVAC systems across the Pacific Northwest, with deep expertise in healthcare, education, data centers, and retrofit projects. We work with top manufacturers to meet performance and sustainability goals—always focused on quality, care, and progress. If you're ready to grow your career, we’re glad you found us. At CMS, you’ll join a team that supports your development and gives you space to make an impact. We review every application carefully and appreciate your interest in growing your career with our team. About Custom Mechanical Solutions Custom Mechanical Solutions (CMS) provides commercial HVAC equipment and technical solutions for complex building applications. We partner with contractors, engineers, building owners, and manufacturers throughout the equipment lifecycle—from system design and delivery through startup, troubleshooting, and field support. As part of the Meriton family of companies, CMS maintains its specialized technical expertise and customer-focused approach while benefiting from the resources and long-term investment of a growing national organization. Title: Quality & Reliability Engineer Department: CMS National Accounts Location: Fully remote within the United States Travel: Approximately 10–20% domestic and international travel Turn field challenges into better products, stronger processes, and more reliable outcomes. Join a growing National Accounts team where your technical judgment, curiosity, and follow-through will connect the jobsite to the factory and help shape how quality is managed as the business scales. The opportunity CMS is looking for a Quality & Reliability Engineer to own and continuously improve the field-to-factory quality feedback loop for custom commercial and industrial HVAC equipment. You will lead technical investigations, turn incomplete field information into clear problem statements, and keep root-cause and corrective-action work moving through verified closure. This is a hands-on, highly collaborative role. You will work across field operations, project teams, customers, engineering, manufacturing, suppliers, and factory quality leaders. Your work will help teams respond faster, create repeatable repairs, reduce recurrence, and apply lessons learned to future projects. Work from where you are. This is a fully remote position that can be based anywhere within the United States. Approximately 10-20% domestic and international travel is expected, including travel to customer sites and manufacturing facilities in Mexico. Travel may be heavier initially while you build relationships with key stakeholders and learn the factory systems. Travel to Mexico is generally expected up to four times per year to support investigations, gather technical evidence, collaborate with factory teams, and validate corrective actions. What you will own Lead field-to-factory investigations. Coordinate quality issues from initial report through containment, root cause, corrective action, and verified closure. Turn field intelligence into action. Gather the technical evidence needed for faster decisions and translate recurring trends into improvements in design, manufacturing, supplier controls, installation guidance, training, and documentation. Create field-ready solutions. Develop clear, controlled Field Service Bulletins with approved repair steps, safety requirements, acceptance criteria, and closeout evidence. Drive clarity and accountability. Keep owners, milestones, risks, decisions, and overdue actions visible. Remove blockers and escalate high-impact or aging issues when needed. Use data to improve the program. Maintain quality dashboards and reports, identify systemic trends and emerging risks, and provide concise updates to leadership, project teams, customers, and factory partners. Go where the evidence is. Travel to customer sites and manufacturing facilities in Mexico to inspect equipment, support troubleshooting, gather evidence, collaborate with factory teams, and validate repair effectiveness. You will probably love this role if... When something fails, your first question is “Why?” and you keep digging until the evidence supports the answer. You enjoy both the technical details and the bigger picture, from walking a jobsite and troubleshooting equipment to explaining the path forward clearly. You take ownership without waiting for every step to be laid out, bring the right people together, and keep work moving until the issue is truly closed. You are comfortable influencing across teams, even when you do not directly manage the people involved. You want to help build and improve a quality program, not simply maintain one. Required qualifications A bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, Manufacturing, or Quality Engineering, or an equivalent combination of technical education and relevant professional experience. At least three years of relevant experience in manufacturing quality, field service, commissioning, reliability engineering, technical investigations, or related technical project support. Strong mechanical and/or electrical investigation and troubleshooting skills. Working knowledge of structured problem-solving methods such as RCA, CAPA, 8D, 5 Why, fishbone analysis, or FMEA. Ability to translate incomplete field information into clear technical problem statements and drive corrective actions through verified closure. Ability to communicate complex technical issues clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences. Ability to travel domestically and internationally approximately 10–20%, including travel to manufacturing facilities in Mexico. A valid passport at the time of hire is preferred; candidates without one must be able to obtain one within the first 90 days of employment. Preferred qualifications Five or more years of relevant quality, reliability, field-service, commissioning, or technical investigation experience. Direct experience with commercial or industrial HVAC equipment. Experience with custom air-handling equipment, controls, construction drawings and specifications, startup, commissioning, or active job-site processes. Experience working directly with manufacturing facilities, suppliers, factory quality teams, or field-service organizations. Experience developing technical repair procedures, Field Service Bulletins, corrective-action documentation, or quality dashboards. Compensation and benefits Base salary: $95,000-$125,000 annually, depending on experience. This position is also eligible for a discretionary bonus. Eligible employees may participate in Meriton’s benefits programs in accordance with applicable plan terms. Why CMS National Accounts You will join a fast-moving team supporting complex equipment and significant projects where expectations are high, and the connection between field performance and customer experience matters. This role offers the opportunity to make quality information more complete, corrective actions more durable, repairs more repeatable, and lessons learned more useful across a growing portfolio. If you are ready to solve meaningful technical problems and help build a stronger quality and reliability program, we would like to hear from you. items.description: Product Headquarters: Remote Storyblok is a headless CMS that enables marketers and developers to create with joy and publish with confidence. It empowers you to deliver structured and consistent content everywhere: websites, apps, AI search, and beyond. Legendary brands like Virgin Media O2, Oatly, and TomTom use Storyblok to make a bigger, faster market impact. WHAT IS IN IT FOR YOU You will be joining a growing company where you can contribute to many “firsts”. Plus these benefits: Monthly remote work stipend (home internet costs, electricity). Home office equipment package right at the start (laptop, keyboard, monitor…) Home office equipment upgrade (furniture, ear plugs …) or membership to a local co-working space after your onboarding Sick leave benefit, parental leave and 25 days of annual leave plus your local national holidays Personal development fund for courses, books, conferences, and material The annual international team-building trip, quarterly and monthly online get-togethers As a fully remote company, with work-life balance at its core, you’ll enjoy flexible schedules An international team that loves to have fun at work and works hard together to accomplish shared goals JOB SUMMARY You will own the reliability, performance, and cost efficiency of the PostgreSQL data platform behind our flagship CMS — primarily Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL — along with the infrastructure and automation around it. This is a reliability engineering role, not a classic administration one. Aurora takes care of patching, backups, failover, and storage growth; you own what it does not — query and index strategy, plan regressions across major version upgrades, vacuum and bloat, connection management, zero-downtime schema change, logical replication, and capacity and cost modeling. Alongside this, you work as a full member of the Infrastructure team on Terraform, CI/CD, observability, and security tooling, and you share the on-call rotation. You will work in a shared-ownership model: backend teams own their queries and schemas, and you own the platform, guardrails, tooling, and knowledge-sharing that make their decisions safe. You will collaborate closely with backend engineers, DevOps engineers, Security, product owners, and the Data team. We measure success by the reliability and predictable performance of the data platform, the quality of your incident response, and how well other engineering teams are equipped to make sound database decisions without you in the room. ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS Database platform (approx. 60%) Own the reliability, performance, and scalability of our PostgreSQL platform (primarily Amazon Aurora): query and index strategy, execution plans, configuration tuning, and capacity planning, with particular attention to hot multi-tenant read paths. Lead zero-downtime version upgrades and schema migrations at scale, including diagnosing and preventing plan regressions across Aurora major versions. Own the operational health of the platform: vacuum strategy and bloat, long-running transactions and wraparound risk, connection management and pooling (including RDS Proxy), lock contention, and logical replication and slot hygiene. Review schema changes and DDL from backend teams for lock behavior, migration safety, and performance impact, and build the guardrails and tooling that make safe changes to the default path. Own backup, restore, and disaster recovery end-to-end, including rehearsed restore drills and the access, encryption, and auditing controls our compliance obligations require. Model database capacity and cost (I/O-Optimized vs. Standard, Serverless v2 sizing, read replica strategy) and drive cost-efficiency without compromising reliability. Infrastructure and automation (approx. 40%) Deliver infrastructure and automation as a full member of the Infrastructure team, using Terraform and cloud-native tooling on AWS, and contribute to CI/CD pipelines including the safe automated handling of database changes. Build and maintain monitoring, alerting, and observability for database and platform systems (e.g. pg_stat_statements, Prometheus exporters, Grafana, Datadog, OpenTelemetry) so problems surface before customers feel them. Use cloud security and vulnerability management tooling (such as Aikido) to triage findings and keep the team's services compliant. Team, incidents, and collaboration Take part in the on-call rotation, incident response, and postmortems, driving root cause analysis and remediation that prevents recurrence. Raise the database competence of the wider engineering organization through design reviews, documentation and runbooks, and mentoring — so this expertise is not concentrated in one person. Demonstrate AI literacy, leveraging AI tools to enhance productivity, decision-making, and quality of work while applying sound judgment and critical thinking. EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE; QUALIFICATIONS Required — PostgreSQL depth 7+ years in database engineering, database reliability, infrastructure, or SRE roles, including significant hands-on ownership of production PostgreSQL. Deep PostgreSQL expertise: internals and MVCC, reading and acting on EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS), indexing strategy, vacuum behavior, locking, connection pooling, and configuration tuning. Strong experience with Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL and AWS-managed database services. Proven track record of zero-downtime upgrades and complex schema migrations on large, busy tables. Hands-on experience with physical and logical replication, partitioning, read scaling, and designing and validating backup and disaster-recovery strategies. Required — Infrastructure and ways of working Solid experience with Infrastructure-as-Code, primarily Terraform, on AWS. Strong Linux fundamentals plus fluency in at least one scripting language (Bash, Python, Ruby, or Go) for automation and tooling. Experience with monitoring and observability tooling, and a solid grasp of security practices (IAM, secrets management, network segmentation). Experience with change, incident, and problem management in production, and with Git and modern CI/CD workflows applied to database changes. Strong written and verbal communication in a remote-first organization, including the ability to explain database trade-offs to backend engineers and non-specialists. Willingness and ability to participate in an on-call rotation. Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Nice to have Familiarity with backend frameworks that interact with PostgreSQL (Ruby on Rails preferred; Python, Rust, or Elixir valued). Experience with caching layers (Redis, Memcached) and their interaction with database load. Exposure to analytics pipelines and warehousing (Redshift, Snowflake, ClickHouse) or CDC-based data flows. Experience with container platforms (ECS, EKS, Fargate), NoSQL or vector databases, or AWS certification (Database – Specialty, DevOps Engineer – Professional). MENTAL, PHYSICAL AND ENVIRONMENTAL REQUIREMENTS Remote (home) work opportunity or funded by Storyblok co-working space GENERAL TERMS Storyblok has a commitment to diversity and inclusion. We strive to create a hiring environment in which all people feel they are equally respected and valued, irrespective of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, age, religion, citizenship or any other characteristic. You can find more information about our privacy policy here . All communications regarding job opportunities at Storyblok will come from an official Storyblok employee with an email address ending in @storyblok.com. We will never redirect you to another portal or another site that is unrelated to our domain ( storyblok.com ). You'll join the Tribe building for managers, the people who plan work, protect margins, and keep projects on time and on budget. You own significant parts of that experience end-to-end, working hands-on with product and design to ship work that matters. You'll do this as we build and launch Toggl 2.0, our consolidated planning, time tracking, and time intelligence product. The salary for this position is €83,000 annually. You can work from anywhere in the world as long as your main location is between UTC-4 and UTC+4. The Role As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you own meaningful parts of the product end-to-end, from the data model and the API to the interface someone actually clicks: the technical approach, the quality of what ships, and whether it actually works for the people using it. You are accountable not for tickets closed, but for clarity, craft, and outcomes. You'll work in the Tribe serving managers, across planning and capacity management, dashboards, and billable work. This is some of the most data-dense, interaction-heavy surface area in the product: schedules and capacity views, reports, and visualizations that have to stay fast and readable at real customer scale. The interesting problems live on both sides of the API here - the query behind a capacity view matters as much as how that view renders. You'll build with React and TypeScript on the frontend and our backend services (mostly Golang) and data layer (Postgres) behind them, alongside a product manager, a designer, and engineers who are used to owning their work and pushing back when something isn't right. In a tribe of 5 other engineers, your impact and visibility are high. Our team meetings are scheduled between 11:00 and 16:00 UTC. Your availability and commitment to participate in these sessions are essential for effective collaboration and team alignment. Your main responsibilities will be: Ownership and delivery Take projects from problem to production. Own the technical approach for major features front to back, break the work down sensibly, sequence it, and ship in slices rather than one big drop. Make the technical calls in your area. Choose between options, name the tradeoffs, and decide without waiting for permission or escalating routine judgment. Keep your work visible without being chased. Flag risks and slips early, keep the Tribe in the loop, and unblock yourself. Craft and quality across the stack Build interfaces people trust with dense, real-world data. Planning views, dashboards, and reports that stay fast, accessible, and readable when the dataset gets ugly. Design the data and API layer those views depend on. Model it so the feature you're building now doesn't make the next three harder. Own performance as a feature, end to end. Profile, measure, and fix the slow query and the slow render instead of hoping the data stays small. Write code others can work in. Sensible components and services, real test coverage where it earns its keep, and a codebase that's easier to change after you touch it. Working with product and design Shape solutions, don't just implement them. Push on the problem, question requirements that don't hold up, and propose simpler paths when you see one. Partner closely with design. Prototype early, spot the edge cases in a flow before it's built, and hold the bar on UX quality with your designer rather than after handoff. Stay close to users and evidence. Join user tests, read the feedback, look at the data, and let it change what you build. Raising the bar Review code with intent. Give precise, actionable feedback that makes the change and the person better. Mentor and interview. Help other engineers grow, and help us hire well. Improve things across team boundaries. Spot shared components and duplicated work between Tribes, and raise it before we build the same thing twice. AI as core leverage Use AI tools extensively in your daily work for exploration, prototyping, code generation and review, debugging, research, and writing. AI fluency is not optional. It's part of how you increase your speed, depth, and impact - and you're expected to help the rest of the Tribe get better at it too. About You You will thrive in this role if you: Have significant experience building and shipping production web applications end to end, and can lead major projects rather than just contribute to them. Are genuinely comfortable on both sides of the stack. You're deep on one side and properly capable on the other, not someone who hands off at the API boundary. Have deep, practical knowledge of JavaScript, TypeScript, React, and modern CSS - including state management and side-effect handling in large applications. Are solid on backend fundamentals: at least one backend language you know well, API design, relational data modelling, and enough instinct for query performance to spot the problem before production does. Prior Golang experience is not mandatory but you have to be willing to adopt it and become comfortable with it fast. Hold an extremely high bar for quality. You know what great looks like, you notice the details others miss, and you don't ship work you wouldn't put your name on. Have a knack for data-heavy product surfaces - performance, readability, and the principles behind a chart that actually communicates something. Care about the user's problem, not just the ticket. You start from what someone is trying to get done and work back to the implementation. Own outcomes, not output. You follow your work into production, watch how it behaves, and fix what needs fixing. Thrive in ambiguity and move fast. You make confident decisions with incomplete information, adapt when things change, and course-correct without drama. Are hands-on with AI tools. You actively use AI as a core part of how you build, not a side experiment, and you have opinions about where it helps and where it doesn't. Don't need to be managed. You set your own direction, keep people in the loop, and ask for help when it matters. Have excellent written and verbal English communication skills. You write clearly, explain technical tradeoffs to non-engineers without jargon, and default to async communication that others can follow. Are eager to contribute to the engineering team's growth - code review, mentoring, and interviewing included. Value transparency, ownership, and speed over perfection. You ship, learn, and improve rather than waiting for the perfect plan. Nice to have: Experience with TanStack is a bonus, and so is a real understanding of frontend caching and eventual consistency, we'd love to hire someone who's dealt with that tradeoff directly. Experience with capacity planning, scheduling, reporting, or other complex B2B SaaS products. Experience working with distributed or microservice systems, a basic understanding of infrastructure and infrastructure as code, and some experience creating, improving, or debugging CI/CD pipelines. This Role Is NOT A ticket-taker role. If you want fully specced work handed to you, this isn't the right fit. A pixel-pusher translating finished designs into code with no say in the problem or the solution. A role where you hand off at the API boundary. If "that's a backend ticket" is your instinct, this will frustrate you. A role where quality is someone else's job. Toggl doesn't have a dedicated QA team or layer: there's no separate team that will catch your bugs, write your tests, or own your performance regressions. A place to work in isolation from users. You'll be expected to know who you're building for and why. A role for people who need heavy process, frequent approvals, or top-down direction to do their best work. The Team We are a global team of ~80 awesome people working from over 40 countries around the globe. We hire globally, you work locally—in the heart of London, a beach outside of Río de Janeiro, or a quiet village near Florence, the choice is yours. Every few months we travel to meet up somewhere in the world and spend some quality time together. We place a huge amount of trust in our people, and we measure the outcomes rather than the work itself. Our values fuel our results. What's Happening at Toggl Toggl is at an exciting turning point. We're taking our best-in-class time tracking - trusted and loved by millions of users worldwide - and expanding it into something bigger: Toggl 2.0 . One product that brings together time tracking, planning, capacity management, reporting, and insight. The idea is simple: better time tracking creates better data, which powers everything else. We call it time intelligence. We build with AI throughout, and we think it's a real multiplier for strong engineers rather than a substitute for them. The judgment, the tradeoffs, and the accountability for what ships stay with people. Benefits Freedom to choose when and how much you work—we only measure results 24 days of paid time off a year, plus your local holidays Unlimited sick leave In-person meetups for team-building (expenses covered) 4-6 weeks paid sabbatical (depending on tenure) Laptop budget up to 2,500€ and it renews every 3 years €2,000 budget to set up your home office and an additional €300 every year after 3 years of tenure €3,000 per year for co-working space membership and/or internet service at home €4,000 per year contribution to use for training, workshops, and conferences €2,400 per year contribution for any equipment or services to improve and/or maintain your physical and mental health Support for buying tools you need for doing your best work (even eyeglasses if you need a new pair) To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/toggl-senior-full-stack

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Remote, Texas, United States, AMER From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven. About Us Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions. As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites. About the Role The Enterprise Account Executive will drive towards aggressive new customer and partner revenue goals, while growing our footprint in the Enterprise market. This is a full-time, remote position and must be based out of Texas in the United States. Please note that the compensation listed below does not include commission (uncapped 50/50 split) or RSU value. What You'll Do Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, customer success, alliances, operations, and analytics to drive pipeline generation and exceed revenue goals. Accelerate the growth & adoption of Fivetran in the Enterprise Market through value-driven sales cycles. Lead in-depth discovery and demonstrate a deep interest in our Enterprise customers’ data challenges, identify required capabilities and positive business outcomes to drive towards valuable long term customer engagements. Speak comfortably about Fivetran’s vision to a broad range of audiences from C-level executives to individual contributors. Seek out and land deals with new Enterprise target accounts, then look to grow their footprint with Fivetran through new use cases, cross-sells and expansion. Build strategic relationships with partners in order to identify new opportunities and accelerate deal cycles. Forecast accurately and provide clear visibility on sales and revenue performance by actively managing and progressing opportunities. Skills We're Looking For 8+ years of large enterprise software sales experience and well-developed pattern recognition for navigating complex organizations. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to hold multiple stakeholders accountable throughout a complex value-driven sales cycle. In-depth familiarity with the modern data technology industry and key players. You are familiar with a solution-based approach to selling, have experience managing a complex sales process and possess excellent presentation and listening skills, organization and contact management capabilities. You thrive in an extremely fast-paced, ever changing work environment. You’re able to keep up with a highly motivated team in a market that is growing extremely fast. You are extremely organized. You are able to juggle lots of things at once while not letting anything drop. You are a strategic thinker. You are able to see and communicate the big picture in an inspiring way. You are a problem solver. You are resilient and creative, able to be resourceful to proactively seek out a solution to a problem. You are enthusiastic! You exhibit passion and excitement for your work and you have a can-do attitude. Previous experience with data integration, database, ETL, or business intelligence technologies is a plus, but not required Please note that the base + uncapped commission compensation listed below does not include RSU value. This position qualifies for Fivetran’s incentive plan, and it’s common for employees in this role to achieve the total on-target earnings. As part of our commitment to setting new hires up for success, all new sales team members attend a one-week, in-person Revenue Bootcamp during their second week at Fivetran. This bootcamp, held at one of our designated company locations, requires travel and is a mandatory part of the onboarding process. The compensation range displayed on this job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire compensation for the target position and level, and may include sales incentives or target bonuses depending on the role. Our compensation ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Our job titles may span more than one career level. Within the range, individual compensation is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, relevant education or training, business need, market demands. The compensation range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. Your recruiter can share more about the specific compensation range for your location during the hiring process. Pay Range $151,351 — $189,189 USD OTE (On Target Earning) $302,702 — $378,378 USD Perks and Benefits 100% employer-paid medical insurance * Generous paid time away from work, including paid vacation or flexible/unlimited vacation depending on role and country, plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave, paid holidays, including a year-end Global Week of Rest, and volunteer days off. RSU stock grants* Professional development and training opportunities Company virtual happy hours, free food, and fun team-building activities Monthly cell phone stipend Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching, and self-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents. * May vary by country and worker type - please reach out to your recruiter for more information Click here to learn more about Fivetran's Benefits by Region. We value and recognize that our customers benefit from having innovative teams made of people from many backgrounds, experiences, and identities. Fivetran promotes diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging through attracting, recruiting, developing, and retaining a diverse workforce, not only because it is the right thing to do, but because it helps us build a world-class company to better serve our customers, our people and our communities. To learn more about Fivetran’s culture and what it’s like to be part of the team, click here and enjoy our video. To learn more about our candidate privacy policy, you can read our statement here . items.description: Position Title : Director, Development Operations Location : U.S. Hybrid (Arlington,VA); or U.S. Remote (proximity to Washington, DC area preferred). Department : Development Reports to: Vice President, Development POSITION SUMMARY The Director of Development Operations leads the operations and operating strategy for the Development team. This role is a strategic leadership position responsible for building an integrated, scalable revenue operation for Winrock. Reporting to the Vice President of Development, this role is key to ensuring senior fundraising leadership’s ability to build strategic donor and partner relationships, grow and diversify revenue, lead major solicitations and negotiations, engage key stakeholders and set fundraising strategy. The Director oversees Winrock’s competitive and non-competitive proposal operations ensuring Winrock has the systems, processes, capacity, and quality standards needed to translate qualified pipeline opportunities into competitive submissions and new awards. The Director of Development Operations owns the operational systems, processes, data, forecasting, and execution disciplines that make sustained fundraising performance possible across Winrock’s diverse funding streams. Critical functions include leadership for annual planning, pipeline management and forecasting; oversight of competitive proposal and capture operations; philanthropy and individual fundraising operations; development of standard operating procedures and performance standards; support for training and capability building. This position manages day-to-day operations of the development function, supervises development operations across Winrock’s diverse funder portfolios, and oversees broader fundraising operations as the organization scales. POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES Development Systems, Data & Analytics (35%) Oversee the systems, data and technology that ensures that Winrock’s Development Team focuses the right people on the right funders at the right time with the right engagement strategy Oversee Salesforce CRM technology stack, administration, and data governance across the Development team and in collaboration with other teams like Information Technology, Private Sector Engagement and Programs, including fundraising software platforms (such as Network for Good and DAFpay), prospect research software (such as Donor Search), and integrations, in partnership with IT and when applicable other functional areas Oversee the utilization and maintenance of event platform and event data as well as event analytics to inform stewardship and cultivation strategies Set data quality standards and oversee management of gift and donor data Establish and maintain knowledge management systems and document/proposal repositories like knowledge library, bid calendars, cases for support, core fundraising materials and language and resource allocation across the pipeline Fundraising Operations & Business Processes (35%) Oversee all the standard operating procedures for the Development Team regarding fundraising, business development, and stewardship for competitive grants and philanthropy from US government, Official Development Assistance, Major Donors, Corporations and Foundations. Design and maintain fundraising and business development workflows, systems, and Standard Operating Procedures including competitive RFP process from pre-positioning through award negotiation to implementation handoff and including philanthropic and individual giving processes such as major gift cultivation, corporate and foundation relations, gift processing and acknowledgements, donor privacy and prospect research and donor intelligence. Lead continuous process improvement across both the competitive RFP proposal lifecycle and fundraising moves management and portfolio management. Lead team project management and workflow coordination across development operations. Manage pipeline and revenue forecasting across all revenue streams (government, bilateral/multi-lateral, foundation, corporate, and individual giving) including the development and maintenance of pipeline reporting, KPI dashboards, regular and ongoing general revenue updates, and the board- and executive-level reporting on fundraising performance. Oversee development budgeting, procurement, and financial reconciliation in partnership with Finance. Coordinate cross-functional collaboration between Development, Programs, Finance, Awards Management, and Compliance. Supervise and mentor development operations staff; lead change management, system adoption, and training initiatives, and foster a culture of continuous learning and excellence. Oversee prospect research and qualification, including wealth screening including portfolio analytics and relationship mapping to inform portfolio assignments and pipeline strategy. Oversee the execution of gift processing. Shared Proposal & Capture Services (including Competitive RFPs) (30%) This role oversees the shared services of staff and consultants who provide surge capacity for capture and proposal development for USG, ODA, and Philanthropy. For philanthropy opportunities, this role also oversees the staff – and may from time-to-time directly provide – grant production, editing, stewardship reporting support, and proposal coordination. Manage the team of full-time staff and consultants supporting fundraising data and technology as well as proposal management. Provide SDA approval on behalf of the Development team for all Go/No-Go and Bid/No-Bid decisions. Approve the resourcing plans for pursuit and proposal delivery by overseeing proposal managers, proposal coordinators, writers/editors, and graphics and production support and managing consultant network. Support Director of USG Portfolio and Director of Philanthropy Portfolio in capture activities, including partner identification and vetting, and qualification of high-level individual and institutional funders. Oversee the development of cost-competitive budgets, budget narratives, and financial projections aligned with technical approaches. Lead team reviews and ensure proposal quality, responsiveness, and compliance. Support the negotiation of contract terms, conditions, and modifications with donors; review and interpret solicitation requirements, translating them into actionable pursuit strategies. Support award start-up planning and implementation, team briefings, and maintain institutional knowledge of donor requirements, regulations, and emerging priorities. POSITION QUALIFICATIONS Education: Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field required; advanced degree in business or non-profit administration (or another relevant field) preferred. Experience: Minimum of 10 years of Development Operations experience with at least 6 years with demonstrated success in managing and leading high-performing Development Operations teams whose activities support: individual giving (major giving, annual giving, gift processing, stewardship, events); institutional philanthropy (corporate and foundation grants); business development functions, including resource management and quality oversight for RFP-driven contracting. Skills & Competencies: Development Operations & Revenue Forecasting Proven track record of managing a Development / Fundraising Operations function and team. Strategic thinker with strong analytical and research skills. Proposal Operations & Resource Management Experience establishing and continuously improving proposal-management systems, processes, tools, templates, and quality standards that enable teams to execute consistently and efficiently. Experience managing department-level and opportunity-specific budgets and external services. Demonstrated ability to manage proposal workloads and surge capacity, including determining staffing needs and effectively deploying employees, consultants, and other technical resources across multiple concurrent opportunities. Strong project, time, and priority management in a fast-paced environment. Cross-Functional Leadership and Collaboration Strong experience partnering with technical, finance, awards management, and senior leadership teams to resolve proposal risks and ensure technically responsive, financially sound, and compliant submissions. Communication and Influence Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present complex information in clear, compelling narratives. Strong relationship-building skills with the ability to engage diverse internal and external (as needed) stakeholders. High level of professionalism, creativity, and diplomatic interpersonal skills. Technical Skills: Proficiency in Microsoft Office is required, including Copilot, required. Experience with CRM platform required. Salesforce strongly preferred. Language: English proficiency required Travel: Up to 15% domestic and occasional international travel for team meetings and organizational events Applicants are encouraged to apply as soon as possible but no later than November 18, 2026. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. The salary range for this position is $155,000 - 170,000 annually, commensurate with experience, skills, and internal equity. Winrock offers competitive pay and an excellent benefits package. No phone calls, please. Candidates selected to move forward will be contacted by email. Winrock is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people. All qualified applicants receive consideration for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, gender, national origin, age, disability or any other basis protected by law. At Winrock we have a clear mission: Empower the disadvantaged, increase economic opportunity and sustain natural resources through unwavering dedication to accountability, equity, innovation, integrity and transformation.

items.description: Nium provides global infrastructure for real-time cross-border payments. We were founded on the mission to deliver the global payments infrastructure of tomorrow, today. Our platform enables banks, fintechs, and global businesses to move money instantly, everywhere. Co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore with offices in 14 markets worldwide, we are entering one of the most exciting chapters in our journey. In March 2026, we delivered the largest month in our 11-year history with record revenue, record volumes, and EBITDA profitability. Today, Nium moves nearly $60B in payments annually, almost entirely for enterprises, while continuing to strengthen an already healthy balance sheet. It is an incredible time to join us, and we are only just getting started. Our payout network spans 190+ countries and 100 currencies, with 100 + corridors in real time. We power seamless transfers to accounts, wallets, and cards, support local collections in 35 markets, and as a principal card issuer on Visa, Mastercard, Discover, and UATP, Nium issues over 50 million card tokens every year. Backed by regulatory licenses in 40+ markets, we make it simple for our partners to onboard, integrate, and scale globally. This scale and innovation have earned us recognition as one of CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025, winner of Best Cross-Border Payments Solution at the PayTech Awards, and inclusion in FXC Intelligence’s Top 100 Cross-Border Payments Companies list. In 2024, we raised US$50 million in Series E funding at a US$1.4 billion valuation to accelerate network expansion, product innovation, and talent growth. With the B2B payments market projected to hit US$175 trillion by 2030, Nium offers ambitious builders the chance to shape the future of global money movement with the scale of a leader and the energy of a high-growth company. The Role Nium is looking for a Card Program Manager to oversee the end-to-end lifecycle, operational performance, and expansion of our global card issuance products. You will be the central operational owner for our card programs, acting as the primary bridge between external partners (card networks, BIN sponsors, issuer processors) and internal product, engineering, and compliance teams. As we aggressively scale our commercial and stablecoin card offerings on the N1 platform, you will ensure these programs launch flawlessly, operate within strict compliance and network rules, and deliver exceptional unit economics. This role sits at the intersection of product operations, partner management, and business strategy, reporting into the Stablecoin product leadership. Responsibilities Manage the end-to-end lifecycle of Nium’s card issuance programs, from partner onboarding and technical implementation to daily operations and optimization. Serve as the primary relationship manager for card networks (Visa, Mastercard), issuing banks/BIN sponsors, issuer processors, and card fulfillment vendors. Partner closely with engineering and product teams to architect and launch commercial stablecoin card programs, ensuring seamless operational alignment with satoshi wallet verification APIs and non-custodial wallet integrations. Own program unit economics, working with finance to track interchange revenue, network fees, processing costs, and overall program profitability. Collaborate with Legal, Risk, and Compliance teams to ensure all card programs strictly adhere to network rules, regional financial regulations, PCI-DSS, and AML/KYC requirements. Lead cross-functional go-to-market readiness for new card products, coordinating with sales, marketing, and customer support to ensure successful market entries. Investigate and resolve escalated program issues, acting as the primary point of contact for major operational incidents affecting cardholders or partners. Develop and maintain comprehensive program documentation, operational runbooks, and partner SLAs. Requirements 7+ years of experience in product operations, program management, or partner management within the fintech, payments, or banking sectors. 3+ years of direct experience managing card issuing programs (credit, debit, or prepaid) and working directly with major card networks (Visa, Mastercard). Deep understanding of the card issuance ecosystem, including issuer processors (e.g., Marqeta, Thales, Galileo), BIN sponsorship models, interchange mechanics, and physical/virtual card fulfillment. Proven ability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder external partnerships and negotiate operational SLAs. Strong foundation in payment compliance, network operating regulations, and financial risk management. Excellent cross-functional leadership skills, with a track record of driving alignment between highly technical engineering PODs and business-oriented commercial teams. Highly analytical mindset with the ability to build performance dashboards, analyze transaction data, and identify operational bottlenecks. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, capable of translating complex network rules into actionable engineering or business requirements. Nice to Have Experience working with card networks and processors Direct experience launching or managing crypto-linked cards, stablecoin payment rails, or Web3 financial products. Prior experience operating card programs across multiple international jurisdictions simultaneously. What we offer at Nium We Value Performance: Through competitive salaries, performance bonuses, sales commissions, equity for specific roles and recognition programs, we ensure that all our employees are well rewarded and incentivized for their hard work. We Care for Our Employees: The wellness of Nium’ers is our #1 priority. We offer medical coverage along with 24 ⁄ 7 employee assistance program, generous vacation programs including our year-end shut down. We also provide a flexible working hybrid working environment (3 days per week in the office). We Upskill Ourselves: We are curious, and always want to learn more with a focus on upskilling ourselves. We provide role-specific training, internal workshops, and a learning stipend. We Celebrate Together: We recognize that work is also about creating great relationships with each other. We celebrate together with company-wide social events, team bonding activities, happy hours, team offsites, and much more! We Thrive with Diversity: Nium is truly a global company, with more than 33 nationalities, based in 18+ countries and more than 10 office locations. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to providing a safe and welcoming environment for everyone. Beware of recruitment scams: Be cautious of individuals impersonating Nium via WhatsApp, social media, email or unofficial websites. Do not respond, share personal or financial information, or make any payments . Nium will never ask candidates to transfer money or cryptocurrency as part of our recruitment process. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

items.description: Data and Analytics SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars. DATA INFRASTRUCTURE OPERATIONS MANAGER (STARLINK) The Infrastructure Operations team is responsible for the end-to-end management of suppliers, costs, and delivery of high-quality human-generated data, including annotations, evaluations, and specialized research datasets that power the training, validation, and continuous improvement of our AI models. We're seeking talented, high-ownership individuals to grow and expand our global supplier network while ensuring the consistent, high-quality delivery of critical datasets. Individuals in this role are creative, fast problem-solvers who seek on challenges outside their comfort zone and can iterate and adapt at the rapid pace of the AI industry. As a Data Infrastructure Operations Manager, you will own end-to-end strategy, sourcing, and delivery for a major data taxonomy category (e.g., agentic tool use, coding, etc.) to drive high-signal datasets that improve model performance. You will be responsible for driving to acquisition and delivery targets for this category. RESPONSIBILITIES: Negotiate creative, flexible, and commercially effective deals with key suppliers and partners Align sourcing strategy with engineering, quality, and performance requirements across priority areas Track deal status, approvals, and execution risks while driving suppliers toward timely and reliable delivery Continuously improve, standardize, and scale sourcing processes, workflows, tools, and planning systems Build a strong pipeline of exclusive and proprietary enterprise datasets Provide valuable inputs on upcoming orders based on supplier capacity, quality, and pricing Maintain rigorous spend discipline, committing budget only to datasets that meaningfully improve model performance Set target pricing, analyze supplier spend and trends, and develop metrics for quality, delivery, and performance Manage clear, proactive communication with both internal stakeholders and external partners BASIC QUALIFICATIONS: 5+ years of experience and a bachelor’s degree, or equivalent experience working in one or more of the following fields: Hardware or product management Engineering Procurement Supply chain management Strategy and operations Technology PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE: Self-starting, able to identify areas for improvement with minimal direction Experience in managing technical or construction projects from beginning to end Ability to tackle complex and ambiguous problems Excellent project management, communication, and organizational skills Experience or interest in data analysis, data visualization, and/or financial analysis Demonstrates commitment to SpaceX’s goals of reusability, renewability, and sustainability ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS: Must be willing to work long hours and occasional weekends when necessary to support launch and critical project timelines COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS: Pay Range: Level 3: $130,000.00 - $185,000.00 Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience. Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees accrue paid sick leave pursuant to Company policy which satisfies or exceeds the accrual, carryover, and use requirements of the law. ITAR REQUIREMENTS: To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here . SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status. Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to EEOCompliance@spacex.com .

items.description: Software Engineering As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn't changed - we're here to stop breaches, and we've redefined modern security with the world's most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We're always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you. About the Role: Are you an SDET who wants to define how AI agents are tested, evaluated and trusted in production? The CrowdStrike Detonations and Threat Analysis Platform Engineering team is hiring a hands-on Software Development Engineer in Test. You'll build and maintain the functional, integration and performance automation that keeps our large-scale, cloud-based cybersecurity platform reliable. You'll also help shape how we test AI. Our core testing frameworks include agentic test generation and analysis, and we use eval-driven development (EDD) to validate the AI agents we build. What You'll Do: Design, develop and maintain automated test suites and frameworks for distributed, cloud-based systems Maintain and extend the agentic test generation and analysis tooling built into our major testing frameworks Build AI-powered workflows and agent skill files that automate manual test toil, such as test data setup, failure triage and release validation Maintain eval suites, golden datasets and scoring pipelines for our AI agents, scoring correctness, tool use, trajectory, faithfulness, safety, latency and cost Enforce CI eval gates so that every change to prompts, models, tools or orchestration is measured before release, and feed production failures back into the eval sets Detect and mitigate unreliable AI output, including hallucinated assertions, flaky or redundant tests, incorrect failure triage and judge bias Design, run and analyze performance, load and stress tests to find bottlenecks and validate scalability across distributed services Validate the integration of platform systems, services, data and applications, as well as customer-facing features end-to-end Review product, system and agent designs for testability, evaluability, flaws and improvements Share knowledge and contribute to the team's quality and evaluation standards What You'll Use: Languages : Java, Node.js, Python, Go Data & Messaging : MongoDB, MinIO, RabbitMQ, Kafka Cloud & Infrastructure : AWS (EC2, S3, DynamoDB), Docker, Nomad, Terraform, Unix/Linux CI/CD & Tooling : Git, Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, Jira, Bitbucket Performance Testing : Locust, k6 AI/Agentic & Evals : LLM APIs, agent frameworks and LLM eval tooling What You'll Need: Degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience (OOP, data structures, algorithms, distributed systems) 5+ years in software quality, including 3+ years of hands-on SDET or test automation development Strong programming skills in at least one of Java, Node.js or Python, with Python preferred for eval and agent work Proven experience designing, building and maintaining test frameworks integrated with CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD) Experience testing web services and APIs (REST, gRPC, JSON) Hands-on experience with performance and load testing using tools such as Locust or k6, including designing realistic workloads and interpreting results (latency percentiles, throughput, error rates) A skeptical, verification-first mindset toward AI output, with a clear sense of when to use deterministic assertions and when to use probabilistic evaluation Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes. Bonus Points: End-to-end eval-driven development experience, including release gating, trajectory and tool-use evals, and calibrating LLM-as-judge against human review Prompt engineering and context or tool design for agents Integrating performance tests into CI/CD and using observability tools (e.g., Grafana, Prometheus, CloudWatch) Background in cybersecurity, threat intelligence, malware analysis or sandboxing/detonation environments #LI-Remote #LI-KM1 Benefits of Working at CrowdStrike: Market leader in compensation and equity awards Comprehensive physical and mental wellness programs Competitive vacation and holidays for recharge Paid parental and adoption leaves Professional development opportunities for all employees regardless of level or role Employee Networks, geographic neighborhood groups, and volunteer opportunities to build connections Vibrant office culture with world class amenities Great Place to Work Certified™ across the globe CrowdStrike is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering a culture of belonging where everyone is valued for who they are and empowered to succeed. We support veterans and individuals with disabilities through our affirmative action program. CrowdStrike is committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all employees and applicants for employment. We base all employment decisions--including recruitment, selection, training, compensation, benefits, discipline, promotions, transfers, lay-offs, return from lay-off, terminations and social/recreational programs--on valid job requirements. If you need assistance accessing or reviewing the information on this website or need help submitting an application for employment or requesting an accommodation, please contact us at recruiting@crowdstrike.com for further assistance. items.summary: Headquarters: Canada (Remote) About the Role: An AI Experience Engineer owns the full lifecycle of the journeys our customers have with Upgrade's AI agent on chat, voice and email: creation, optimization, edge case handling and containment growth. They build journeys in Sierra's no-code tooling, partner with Upgrade's product groups to bring their
items.description: Back-End Programming Headquarters: Canada (Remote) About the Role: An AI Experience Engineer owns the full lifecycle of the journeys our customers have with Upgrade's AI agent on chat, voice and email: creation, optimization, edge case handling and containment growth. They build journeys in Sierra's no-code tooling, partner with Upgrade's product groups to bring their servicing flows to the agent, and are accountable for whether the agent resolves the customer's issue safely, accurately and without a human. We are hiring an AI Experience Engineer to own Upgrade's customer-facing AI agent. You will sit between engineering, product and customer operations. You will turn servicing workflows, such as making a payment, checking loan details, updating an address or enabling autopay, into production journeys and keep improving them after launch. You will build and own the journeys end to end, from first draft to steady state. The work is part builder, part analyst: design the flow, handle the edge cases, read the transcripts, and keep raising containment. Containment, CSAT, transfer quality and hallucination rate are your metrics. Within your first year, you will own a portfolio of journeys across products (Personal Loans, Card, BNPL, HELOC, Deposits) and help set the standards for how Upgrade builds, tests and ships AI experiences. Our Core Technologies Sierra Agent Studio (no-code journeys), Sierra simulations and conversation analytics, GraphQL and REST APIs (as journey tools), Genesys (contact center handoff), SumoLogic, Grafana, SQL, Javascript/Typescript, Claude and other LLM tools. What You'll Do • Journey creation: Design and build Sierra journeys in Agent Studio for chat, voice and email, from discovery with operations through production rollout • Optimization: Review transcripts, recordings and analytics every week, find where conversations fail or transfer, and ship fixes to journey logic, instructions and knowledge • Edge case handling: Map the unhappy paths (failed payments, mismatched identity, delinquent accounts, unsupported requests) and make sure each ends in a correct answer or a clean handoff • Containment: Own containment and CSAT targets per journey, run staged rollouts (1% → 100%), and prioritize the work that moves those numbers most • Product partnership: Work with product groups (Personal Loans, Card, BNPL, Deposits) to scope new journeys, keep journeys current as products change, and define the APIs the agent needs • Safety and compliance: Apply tiered authentication and step-up verification, verbatim compliance language and guardrails against hallucination and off-policy answers • Handoffs: Design transfers to human agents in Genesys with accurate summaries and auth context • Testing: Build simulation and regression suites so every journey change ships with evidence it did not break existing behavior • Monitoring: Watch latency, errors and drop-offs in SumoLogic and Grafana, and own the alerts • Voice tuning: Latency, filler phrases, interruptions, personality and tone • Sierra relationship: Be the technical owner on our side, escalate platform issues and shape roadmap asks What We Look For: • 3–5 years of Frontend Software Engineering experience, or equivalent experience in Solutions Engineering, Conversational AI or Technical Product roles • Working knowledge of how LLM agents behave: instructions, tool calls, knowledge retrieval, and where each one fails • Experience building evaluations for non-deterministic systems: test sets, simulations, LLM-as-judge, regression gates • Enough technical depth to read API specs, work with backend engineers on REST and GraphQL integrations, and reason about authorization and permission scopes • Working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript, with the ability to build and maintain coded journeys and integrate APIs within conversational AI platforms. • Product and customer mindset: you understand ops procedures, you read transcripts, care about tone, and measure success by whether the customer's problem got solved • Ownership in production: rollouts, monitoring, log analysis and incident response • Clear writing and the ability to work with non-engineers in operations, compliance and legal Nice To Have: • Hands-on experience with Sierra Agent Studio, or a comparable no-code agent platform (Decagon, Ada, Kore.ai, Google CCAI, Amazon Lex/Connect) • Voice AI experience: speech-to-text, text-to-speech, latency tuning, barge-in handling • Contact center systems such as Genesys, and agent handoff design • Background in fintech or another regulated industry (UDAAP, FDCPA, TCPA, PCI, SOC 2) • Conversation design or UX writing experience What We Offer You: • Competitive salary ($140K-$180K CAN) and stock option plan • Paid coverage of medical, dental and vision insurance • Flexible PTO • Opportunities for professional growth and development • Paid parental leave • Health & wellness initiatives To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/upgrade-ai-experience-engineer-conversational-ai

items.title: AI Researcher – Multilingual Data
items.summary: About the RoleWe’re looking for an AI Researcher focused on multilingual data to help us build and scale next-generation language models across diverse languages and domains.
items.description: About the Role We’re looking for an AI Researcher focused on multilingual data to help us build and scale next-generation language models across diverse languages and domains. You’ll own research and execution around data sourcing, curation, evaluation, and training strategies for multilingual and low-resource languages, with a strong emphasis on publishing high-quality research and translating it into production systems. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working close to the frontier: balancing papers, prototypes, and real-world impact in a fast-moving startup environment. What You’ll Do Design and execute research on multilingual datasets , including data collection, filtering, deduplication, and quality measurement Develop strategies for low-resource and long-tail languages (sampling, augmentation, curriculum design) Research and improve cross-lingual transfer , alignment, and robustness in large language models Build and maintain evaluation benchmarks for multilingual performance Collaborate with engineers and researchers on training pipelines and model architecture decisions Publish research at top venues (e.g., ACL, EMNLP, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR) and contribute to open-source when appropriate Translate research insights into practical improvements in production models What We’re Looking For Strong background in NLP / ML research , with a focus on multilingual or cross-lingual modeling Publication record at respected conferences or journals (ACL, EMNLP, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, etc.) Experience working with large-scale text datasets across multiple languages Solid understanding of: Tokenization and vocabulary design for multilingual models Data quality metrics, filtering, and dataset bias Transfer learning and multilingual representation learning Comfortable prototyping in Python with modern ML frameworks (PyTorch, JAX, etc.) Ability to operate independently and ship research in a startup pace environment Nice to Have Experience with low-resource languages or non-Latin scripts Open-source contributions in NLP or data tooling Experience training or evaluating large language models Familiarity with multilingual benchmarks (e.g., XTREME, FLORES, TyDi QA) Why Join Us Real ownership over research direction and impact A team that values papers and production Access to meaningful scale: large datasets, modern infrastructure, and fast iteration Competitive compensation and meaningful equity at an early stage Originally posted on Himalayas

And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers' evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. Job Description We are looking for a Software Engineer, Senior Consultant I with hands-on experience in Kong API and AI Gateway technology, cloud platforms, and infrastructure automation. The ideal candidate should have experience supporting and managing API platforms, working with Linux-based systems, and automating deployments using Infrastructure as Code tools. Candidates must be able to work CT or ET hours. Required Skills Good experience in API Management and Gateway technologies. Hands-on experience with Kong API Gateway administration, configuration, and troubleshooting. Strong knowledge of Linux operating systems and shell scripting. Experience with AWS services such as EC2, VPC, Load Balancers, IAM, CloudWatch, and EKS. Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform . Experience with configuration management and automation using Ansible . Understanding of REST APIs, API security, OAuth, JWT, SSL/TLS, and networking concepts. Experience with CI/CD pipelines and source control tools such as Git. Ability to diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve production issues. Responsibilities Deploy, configure, and support Kong API Gateway environments. Automate infrastructure provisioning and application deployments using Terraform and Ansible. Monitor platform health, troubleshoot incidents, and drive issue resolution. Work closely with development and platform teams to onboard and manage APIs. Implement security, performance, and reliability best practices. Support AWS-based infrastructure and containerized environments. Good to Have Experience with AI Gateway implementations and AI/LLM integrations. Exposure to Kubernetes and container platforms. Knowledge of Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, or other monitoring tools. Experience with Apigee or other API management platforms. Skills Amazon Web Services (AWS), Ansible (Software), API Management, Gateway Software, Linux, Software Development, Terraform (Software) Compensation Compensation offered for this role is 85,000.00 - 145,075.00 annually and is based on experience and qualifications. items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: New York, NY; Remote, US (Hub cities) Maven Clinic is the world's largest virtual clinic for women and families on a mission to make healthcare work for all of us. Through Maven Enterprise, the company partners with more than 2,300 employers and health plans to provide end-to-end women's and family health programs spanning fertility and family building, maternity and newborn care, parenting and pediatrics, and menopause and midlife — improving clinical outcomes, reducing healthcare costs, and expanding equitable access to high-quality care at scale. Through its consumer platform, Maven provides direct access to virtual care across 30+ specialties, as well as dedicated hormone and GLP-1 care programs purpose-built for women. Founded in 2014 by CEO Kate Ryder, Maven Clinic has raised more than $425 million from leading healthcare and technology investors including General Catalyst, Sequoia, Dragoneer Investment Group, Oak HC/FT, StepStone Group, Icon Ventures, and Lux Capital. Recognized for innovation and industry leadership, Maven has been named to the TIME100 Most Influential Companies, CNBC Disruptor 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, and FORTUNE Best Places to Work. Learn more at mavenclinic.com An award-winning culture working towards an important mission – Maven Clinic is a recipient of over 30 workplace and innovation awards, including: TIME 100 Most Influential Companies (2023, 2026) Fortune Change the World (2024) CNBC Disruptor 50 List (2022, 2023, 2024) Fortune Best Workplaces for Millennials (2024) Fortune Best Workplaces in Health Care (2024) Fast Company Most Innovative Companies (2020, 2023) Fortune Best Workplaces NY (2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024) Maven is looking for a commercially-minded and strategic Client Success Manager to join our Client Success team, to own relationships with our employer accounts. The Client Success Manager will be the main point of contact for employer accounts introduced through Maven’s channel partnerships - driving enrollment and engagement while taking direct accountability for net revenue retention, renewal health, and expansion readiness. You’ll translate member outcomes into quantifiable business value for clients, orchestrate cross-functional motions with Sales, Renewals, Product, and Analytics, and build the strategic account plans that protect and grow Maven’s revenue. This is not a reactive support role, it’s a commercial position that requires equal parts relationship depth, analytical rigor, and business acumen. This person will be on the front lines as a trusted advisor to our clients and a key partner to our channel partnership teams. As Client Success Manager at Maven, you will: Support the success and satisfaction of your portfolio of employer clients, helping ensure strong client retention and engagement Collaborate with channel/payer partner client executives to manage broader strategic client relationships and unlock additional business opportunities within your portfolio Assist in building and maintaining account plans, tracking renewal milestones, and identifying opportunities for growth. Monitor client health and engagement on an ongoing basis, flagging potential risks early and collaborating with your manager and team to develop mitigation plans. Identify potential opportunities for client expansion and collaborate with Sales to build business cases and handoffs. Partner with Sales and Renewals teams to ensure smooth account transitions and handoffs, contributing to clear narratives and data-supported recommendations. Support client enrollment and engagement initiatives that drive measurable business outcomes, such as employee utilization, satisfaction, or program adoption. Participate in Quarterly Business Reviews and other client-facing presentations, sharing data insights and supporting renewal or expansion discussions. Consult clients on program optimization using Maven’s expertise, benchmark data, and program resources, ensuring measurable business impact. Maintain strong client relationships, fostering satisfaction, loyalty, and advocacy, and supporting case studies or success stories where appropriate. Collaborate with cross-functional teams (product, engineering, analytics, marketing) to support client projects, timelines, and deliverables. Manage client inquiries, issues, and escalations, coordinating with partner teams as needed to resolve challenges. Share client insights internally to help improve products, processes, and marketing initiatives. Recommend improvements to client workflows or processes, supporting scalable solutions to enhance outcomes. What we’re looking for you to bring: 5+ years of experience in account management, customer success, or client services within digital health, healthcare, benefits, or SaaS companies, with demonstrated ability to manage client relationships and contribute to commercial outcomes. Experience working with enterprise employer clients through channel/payer partners (5,000+ employees) preferred. Proven ability to support and execute marketing or engagement strategies that drive measurable client outcomes. Passion for healthcare and supporting organizational change. Collaborate with internal teams to deliver a seamless experience for clients, providing insights that inform product, process, or market improvements. History of contributing to client retention, renewal management, and account growth opportunities. Ability to build and maintain relationships with multiple stakeholders (HR, Benefits, Finance), navigating client environments effectively. Experience partnering with Sales or Renewals teams to support commercial opportunities and account growth. Strong interpersonal, verbal, written, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and influence internal and external stakeholders. Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks while ensuring deadlines and deliverables are met. Analytical skills and strategic thinking – able to translate data and client performance into actionable insights in collaboration with clients. Experience supporting the full lifecycle of customer success post-sales (implementation, adoption, product training, renewals, and account management). Comfort operating in a growing and evolving environment, adaptable to changing processes and ambiguity. Willingness to travel occasionally (up to 20%) for client meetings and participate in our NYC office when needed. Helpful experiences and skills (not required, can be learned on the job): Experience at a digital health company in health, wellness, or family health space. Experience with managing high volume of clients is preferred Experience supporting health benefit programs for employer or payer clients. Experience with Salesforce, Gainsight, Looker, and Microsoft Office suite. The base salary range for this role is $106,000 - 120,000 per year. You will also be entitled to receive equity and benefits. Individual pay decisions are based on qualifications, experience, and skillset. New York, NY; Remote, US (Hub cities) Maven embraces a flexible hybrid work model. Our teams primarily operate from the New York Metropolitan area, NY, San Francisco/Bay Area, CA, and Seattle, WA.
