items.description: Company Description Accesa is a leading technology company headquartered in Cluj-Napoca, with offices in Oradea and 20 years of experience in turning business challenges into opportunities and growth. A value-driven organisation, it has established itself as a partner of choice for major brands in Retail, Manufacturing, Finance, and Banking. It covers the complete digital evolution journey of its customers, from ideation and requirements setup to software development and managed services solutions. With more than 1,200 IT professionals, Accesa also has a fast-growing footprint, establishing itself as an employer of choice for IT professionals who are passionate about problem-solving through technology. Coming together in strong tech teams with a customer-centric approach, they enable businesses to grow, delivering value for our clients, partners, industry, and community. Job Description Accesa is building a dedicated STACKIT cloud delivery team, and we are looking for engineers who want to be part of this initiative from the start. You will bring your existing cloud and DevOps experience and develop expertise in STACKIT through a planned onboarding and learning phase using STACKIT University, expected to take approximately 6–8 weeks. You will learn alongside an architect and experienced DevOps colleagues, then apply that knowledge to building reusable infrastructure solutions and preparing the team for customer delivery. This is an opportunity to help shape a new cloud capability: contribute to technical decisions, establish engineering practices, and take solutions from initial exploration to implementation. Previous STACKIT experience is welcome but not required. Engineers with AWS, Azure, GCP, or OpenStack experience and strong infrastructure fundamentals are encouraged to apply. Responsibilities Build STACKIT expertise: Develop STACKIT knowledge through STACKIT University and practical implementation work. Manage cloud infrastructure: Design, provision, and maintain cloud infrastructure using Terraform or OpenTofu. Configure cloud networking: Manage IP addressing, routing, DNS, and firewall rules. Implement secure access: Configure IAM, access controls, and secure configuration practices. Operate containerized workloads: Deploy and manage containerized workloads on STACKIT Kubernetes Engine (SKE). Administer cloud environments: Manage and troubleshoot Linux systems and cloud environments. Automate deployments: Build and improve CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation. Ensure operational visibility: Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting to support reliable operations. Create reusable solutions: Collaborate with architects and engineers to develop reusable infrastructure modules, documentation, and operational practices. Support customer delivery: Contribute to technical discovery and customer delivery as the STACKIT capability develops. Qualifications Must have Hands-on experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, Platform Engineering, or a similar role. Practical experience with at least one cloud platform: AWS, Azure, GCP, OpenStack, or STACKIT. Strong Infrastructure as Code skills using Terraform or OpenTofu. Solid Linux administration and troubleshooting skills. Good understanding of networking fundamentals, including CIDR notation, routing, DNS, and firewall rules. Practical experience with Kubernetes and containerized workloads. Understanding of IAM and cloud security practices. Experience with Git, CI/CD tooling, and deployment automation. Scripting skills in Bash, Python, or a similar language. Ability to work independently, take ownership, and contribute to technical decisions. Good English communication skills. Motivation to learn STACKIT and help build a new delivery team. Nice to Have Previous experience with STACKIT cloud services. Experience with cloud migrations or setting up new cloud environments. Experience creating reusable Terraform/OpenTofu modules. Familiarity with Helm, GitOps, Prometheus, and Grafana. What Makes This Opportunity Different You will join an initiative in its early stages, with a planned learning phase through STACKIT University and the opportunity to work alongside an architect and experienced engineers. Your contribution will help define how the team builds infrastructure, automates delivery, and supports future customer projects. Additional Information As a people-first organisation, we believe diversity strengthens our teams and drives innovation. All employment decisions are based on merit, skills, and performance, without discriminating based on any personal characteristic. This reinforces our commitment to providing an inclusive and respectful workplace. At Accesa you can: Enjoy our holistic benefits program that covers the four pillars that we believe come together to support our wellbeing, covering social, physical, emotional wellbeing, as well as work-life fusion. Physical Wellbeing: Our wellbeing program includes medical benefits, gym support, and personalized fitness options for an active lifestyle, complemented by team events and the Healthy Habits Club. Work-Life Fusion: In very dynamic industries such as IT, the line between our professional and personal lives can quickly become blurred. Having a one-size-fits-one approach gives us the flexibility to define the work-life dynamic that works for us. Emotional Wellbeing: We believe that to maintain our overall health, we need to invest in our mental wellbeing just as much as we do in our physical health, social connections or in achieving work-life balance. Social Wellbeing: As a growing community in a hybrid environment, we want to ensure we remain connected not just by the great work we do every day but through our passions and interests.

items.description: Customer Support Headquarters: Nairobi URL: http://m-kopa.com Join our expanding Product Growth team! We’re actively recruiting a Senior CRM Manager as we continue to scale at M-KOPA. Most senior growth hires get one channel and one pod for years. This role is built differently: you’ll own two of our core growth pods in your first year, then land where you’ve had the most impact. It’s a fast track to pod leadership, not a support seat. The Impact 💚 You’ll drive the conversion growth that turns customers into long-term, high-value ones, creating financial inclusion for Africa’s traditionally excluded. We’ve already helped over 10 million customers access over $2 billion in credit 🌍 The Opportunity 🏗️ Real ownership from day one. You'll be the one accountable for delivery in Repeat Phones, not shadowing or supporting someone else's plan. 🎒 Two growth motions, one year. You'll take on Digital Lending mid-way through, working directly with one of our strongest performers to understand cash loans end to end, then carry that pod solo for a defined stretch. Few people get this breadth this early. 🧭 A defined path, not indefinite floating. You'll build real expertise in our two conversion pods first, then move into Lifecycle in the second half of next year, reporting to the Lifecycle CRM Lead once you're there. The destination is set. What you bring to it is up to you. 🌍 Work inside a proven CLV engine. M-KOPA has helped more than 10 million customers access over $2 billion in credit. You'll be executing inside systems that already work, not guessing at what might. What You'll Do Phase 1 : Repeat Phones. Take ownership of reactivation and upgrade campaigns in CleverTap, working closely with the Growth Lead there to understand what's driving the pod's numbers and where the next opportunity is. You'll be trusted to make real calls here, not just execute a checklist. Phase 2 : Cross into Digital Lending. Work directly with the Digital Lending lead, one of our top performers, to understand cash loan growth end to end before taking it on yourself. Phase 3 : Own Digital Lending. Carry primary responsibility for Digital Lending for a defined period, with the Repeat Phones lead available if you need a second opinion. Phase 4 : Move into Lifecycle. In the second half of next year, join the Lifecycle pod full-time, reporting to the Lifecycle CRM Lead. You'll bring a year of hands-on conversion experience into a pod that's still being built, real currency for shaping what Lifecycle does next. Throughout all phases, you will: Build and run multi-channel campaigns (SMS, WhatsApp, push, in-app) in CleverTap against pod goals Track funnel performance and flag drop-off points to the pod lead you're supporting Run structured experiments (creative, audience, incentive, or timing) with clear hypotheses Turn what works into documented playbooks the next person can pick up Keep data quality and campaign tracking clean enough that leadership can trust the numbers Key Metrics You'll Influence Repeat Phones: Reactivation rate, upgrade conversion %, unit economics per sale Digital Lending: Approval → disbursement rate, digital loan volume, approval quality Campaign ROI and payback period across both Your Environment 💼 Tech Stack: CleverTap (primary), Looker Channels: WhatsApp, SMS, push, in-app messaging Markets: Kenya, Nigeria, Uganda, Ghana What You Need 5+ years in growth, performance, or lifecycle marketing, ideally in fintech, telco, or e-commerce, with real ownership over what a campaign or a pod achieved, not just involvement in it. Judgment as much as skill. You can walk into a pod, understand what's working and why, and make calls on where to push, not just follow a brief. Genuine appetite for pod leadership. This is a deliberate path toward owning a pod outright, and the breadth here is designed to get you there faster than a single-channel role would. Hands-on fluency in CRM platforms like CleverTap, Braze, or similar, and comfortable reading a funnel or cohort without translation. Energized, not unsettled, by ambiguity. You'll work across two pods and land in a third decision point by mid-year. If that sounds like an opportunity rather than a risk, you'll thrive here. Strong enough presence to build trust quickly with senior leads across two different pods. Location & Benefits 🌍 Fully remote role within UTC -1 to UTC +3 time zones 🤝 Work with diverse teams across UK, Europe, and Africa 📚 Professional development programmes and coaching partnerships 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Family-friendly policies and flexible working arrangements 💚 Well-being support and career growth opportunities Our Mission 🌍 We create financial inclusion for the traditionally excluded through a fair, flexible, customer-centric financing model. We strive to drive greater inclusion of women, youth, and low-income communities. Our Impact 💚 Our technology has created measurable change: Connected 📱: 2.5 million first-time smartphone users connected Prosperous 💰: 70% of customers use M-KOPA products for income generation, with 35,000+ livelihoods created for agents Green 🌱: 2.1 million tonnes of CO₂ avoided through clean energy products, with over 127,700 circular economy products provided Why M-KOPA? At M-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on-the-job training. We support individual journeys with family-friendly policies, prioritize well-being, and embrace flexibility. Join us in shaping the future of M-KOPA as we grow together. Explore more at m-kopa.com . Recognized four times by the Financial Times as one Africa's fastest growing companies (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026), named on CNBC's World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025 & 2026 and by TIME100 Most influential companies in the world 2023 and 2024 , we've served over 10 million customers, unlocking $2 billion in cumulative credit for the everyday earners across Africa, in addition to over 10,000 e-bikes financed in Kenya. Important Notice M-KOPA is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer committed to assembling a diverse, broadly trained staff. Women, minorities, and people with disabilities are strongly encouraged to apply. M-KOPA explicitly prohibits the use of Forced or Child Labour and respects the rights of its employees to agree to terms and conditions of employment voluntarily, without coercion, and freely terminate their employment on appropriate notice. M-KOPA shall ensure that its Employees are of legal working age and shall comply with local laws for youth employment or student work, such as internships or apprenticeships. M-KOPA does not collect/charge any money as a pre-employment or post-employment requirement. This means that we never ask for ‘recruitment fees’, ‘processing fees’, ‘interview fees’, or any other kind of money in exchange for offer letters or interviews at any time during the hiring process. Applications for this position will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Shortlisting and interviews will take place at any stage during the recruitment process. We reserve the right to close the vacancy early if a suitable candidate is selected before the advertised closing date. If your application is successful M-KOPA undertakes pre-employment background checks as part of its recruitment process, these include; criminal records, identification verification, academic qualifications, employment dates and employer references. items.title: FirstPrinciples Research Fellow
items.summary: Overview: FirstPrinciples is a non-profit organization building an autonomous AI Physicist to understand the nature of reality: the underlying structure, governing principles, and fundamental laws of our universe.
items.description: Overview: FirstPrinciples is a non-profit organization building an autonomous AI Physicist to understand the nature of reality: the underlying structure, governing principles, and fundamental laws of our universe. We're developing an intelligent system that can explore theoretical frameworks, reason across disciplines, and generate novel insights to tackle the deepest unsolved problems in physics. By combining AI, symbolic reasoning, and autonomous research capabilities, we're developing a platform that goes beyond analyzing existing knowledge to actively contribute to physics research. Our goal is to accelerate progress on the questions that have captivated humanity for centuries. We operate as a global nonprofit organization , with a Canadian foundation, a US-based 501(c)(3). As part of this effort, we are launching a Research Fellowship Program for advanced AI and physics researchers. Fellows will work directly with the FirstPrinciples Research and Engineering teams to design, test, and implement state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods and applications that will be integrated into the core AI Physicist system. This is not a paper-only fellowship and your work will go straight into production, helping shape how scientific research is performed. What You will DoAs a Research Fellow, you will own a well-scoped research direction that contributes directly to the AI Physicist's ability to reason about physics. Core Objectives: Improve Theo’s ability to produce scientifically sound, high-quality outputs in 2026; Introduce new ideas, methods, and approaches that meaningfully shift system performance; Bring deep domain expertise (PhD+ level) in one or more targeted research areas. Research Areas & Responsibilities Fundamental Model Research : Research, design, and test novel model architectures that combine academic literature, NLP, symbolic reasoning, and structured scientific workflows. Prototype and build embedding representations for physical concepts, mathematical objects, and logical structures, enabling models to reason over equations, abstractions, and scientific constraints rather than surface text alone. Investigate alternatives to transformer-based architectures and deliver concrete recommendations. Design and run targeted experiments to evaluate new architectural ideas, using empirical results to guide the development of next-generation model architectures. Develop reinforcement learning loops that enable models to run internal and independent thought experiment. Multimodal Data & Benchmarking : Design and automate scalable data ingestion pipelines that aggregate scientific literature, metadata, equations, and experimental data. Create custom benchmarks to measure physical understanding, mathematical reasoning, and failure modes in scientific reasoning and abstraction. Refine and release curated datasets and baselines once internal validation is complete. Training, Testing & Safety : Run and track model training jobs while managing compute usage and budget constraints. Design sandbox environments for controlled autonomous exploration. Build evaluation frameworks using visual and statistical tools to identify strengths and blind spots. Implement tests and guardrails that flag low-quality or unsafe outputs. Maintain internal issue tracking with clear failure modes and fixes. Collaboration & Technical Guidance : Work closely with engineers to ensure research is feasible and production-ready. Communicate technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders. Present regular research updates tied to defined milestones. Who This Fellowship Is ForWe are looking for researchers who: Can operate independently and own a problem end-to-end. Are motivated by ambitious, long-horizon goals. Have strong builder instincts, not just theory. Value rigor, clarity, and intellectual honesty. Are comfortable engaging with exploratory, incomplete results. Typical profiles include: PhD or postdoctoral researchers in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Theoretical Physics, or a closely related field. Track record of research in either: model architectures, representation learning, or reasoning systems (CS/ML path); or mathematical, physical, or formal reasoning applied to fundamental problems (physics path). Demonstrated ability to translate abstract theory into testable computational systems. Comfortable working across disciplinary boundaries. Program Structure 6-12 month engagement with full-time or equivalent commitment Fully remote Fellows participate in projects and are expected to produce outputs (code, models, and other deliverables) Fixed stipend for the full term How to Express Interest:If this resonates, we welcome an expression of interest, including: Resume; Description of your research background; Primary areas of expertise; and Relevant recent work. Join us at FirstPrinciples and be a part of a transformative journey where science drives progress and unlocks the potential of humanity. Originally posted on Himalayas

Our digital suite of solutions connects manufacturers, suppliers, and a global network of more than 250 auditors and quality experts
items.description: Description About Qualifyze: Founded in 2019, Qualifyze is a leading company in supply chain compliance management in the Life Sciences industry, trusted by over 1,500 pharmaceutical and healthcare companies globally. Our digital suite of solutions connects manufacturers, suppliers, and a global network of more than 250 auditors and quality experts. With a track record of over 4,500 audits across 85+ countries and the largest and most accurate supplier network and data analytics tools, Qualifyze stands as the all-in-one partner for quality compliance and supply chain risk mitigation in the Life Sciences sector. Requirements Role overview: We are looking for a driven and results-oriented Territory Account Executive to join our Growth team and play a key role in accelerating our expansion. In this position, you will take full ownership of the sales cycle within your assigned region, transforming both inbound and outbound opportunities into long-term customer relationships. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys building meaningful client connections, and is motivated by closing deals and delivering measurable impact. You will work cross-functionally with internal teams to refine sales strategies, contribute to process improvements, and help shape the future of our commercial success. Main responsibilities: Own the full-cycle sales process from prospecting to expanding existing customer relationships. Engage with both inbound and outbound leads to drive new business. Reactivate dormant accounts and turn one-off transactions into recurring revenue. Consistently meet or exceed sales targets and KPIs. Maintain accurate records and pipeline hygiene in the CRM. Collaborate cross-functionally with internal teams to align on sales strategies and customer success. Contribute to the ongoing refinement of sales processes, tools, and playbooks. Main requirements: Professional proficiency in English and Mandarin/Chinese, any additional language is a plus. Previous experience in a sales role, preferably within B2B and/or Life Sciences industries. Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build relationships and engage with clients at all levels. Experience with CRM tools (HubSpot preferred) and managing pipelines. Highly organized with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple accounts and priorities effectively. Self-motivated and capable of working independently while collaborating with cross-functional teams. A pragmatic approach to problem-solving and driving results. Nice to have: Experience in the pharma industry or knowledge of quality compliance and auditing processes. What do we offer? ⏳ Flexible schedules throughout the year. 🌍 The option to work from abroad for up to 45 days per year. 💻 All necessary work equipment (laptop, headphones, etc.). 🎉 Annual in person all company event and celebration in Europe. 🚀 Individual coaching and mentoring on your development roadmap within Qualifyze.

items.title: Creative (Graphic Designer)
items.summary: Superside is looking for a talented Graphic Designer to join our global creative team. You'll create standout visual work for some of the world's most ambitious brands: from brand identity and campaign design to digital and social assets. You’ll be working alongside creative leads, project managers, and clients across a wide range of industries. This is a hands-on design role built for the way design actually gets made today. You'll spend most of your time designing, building concepts, refining visual systems, and pushing craft, using today's leading AI creative tools as a core part of your process, not an afterthought. We're looking for designers who already treat tools & models like Flora, Krea, Figma AI, Claude, NanoBanana, GPT Image, and Seedance as part of their everyday kit, and who know when to reach for them and when strong traditional craft is what the work actually needs.
